domains.name: beneficiary
domains.description: Single source of truth for all individuals, households, and communities served by humanitarian and development programs. Owns beneficiary identity, registration, vulnerability profiling, needs assessments, consent management, and case management. Covers IDPs, PoCs (Persons of Concern), GBV survivors, and all target populations tracked in CommCare and KoboToolbox.

products.name: registrant
products.description: Core master entity for every individual registered as a beneficiary or person of concern (PoC). Stores biographic data (name, date of birth, sex, nationality), unique beneficiary ID, registration source system (CommCare, KoboToolbox), protection flags, deduplication status, and full registration metadata including registration date, location, modality (in-person, mobile, remote), registration tool, registering staff, verification documents presented, completeness score, and deduplication check results. Supports re-registration tracking with historical registration events. Serves as the single identity anchor for all beneficiary-domain transactions. Interoperable with UNHCR proGres v4 individual records, WFP SCOPE beneficiary records, and RAIS case records via standard beneficiary ID mapping.
products.reference: UNHCR Individual Registration / CommCare Case Master

attributes.name: registrant_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each registrant record in the beneficiary domain. Serves as the primary key and identity anchor for all beneficiary-domain transactions across CommCare, KoboToolbox, and interoperability mappings to UNHCR proGres v4, WFP SCOPE, and RAIS.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Beneficiary Identity Management

attributes.name: deduplication_master_registrant_id
attributes.description: The beneficiary_id of the authoritative master record when this registrant has been identified as a duplicate. Null for unique records. Enables lineage tracing from duplicate to canonical record for audit and reporting.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Beneficiary Deduplication Policy; UNHCR proGres v4 Deduplication Module

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this registrant to their household unit. Enables household-level aggregation for NFI distribution, WASH targeting, and food security assessments. Household head registrant carries the authoritative household record.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Household Linkage; WFP SCOPE Household Model; Sphere Association Household Standards

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Externally-known unique beneficiary identifier assigned at registration, used for cross-system interoperability with UNHCR proGres v4, WFP SCOPE, and RAIS case records. Printed on beneficiary cards and referenced in all program transactions.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Individual Record Standard; IATI Beneficiary Identification Guidelines

attributes.name: project_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.project_site. Business justification: Beneficiary registration occurs at specific field sites (health posts, distribution points, registration centers). Essential for geographic program planning, site-level performance reporting, and link

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sanctions_screening. Business justification: Nonprofits must screen beneficiaries against OFAC, UN, EU sanctions lists before providing assistance per donor compliance requirements (USAID, FCDO, EU). Mandatory regulatory process for counter-terr

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the staff member or community health worker who conducted the registration. Used for accountability, data quality audits, and field staff performance monitoring. Links to workforce.staff_member.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; CommCare User Management; HRIS Integration

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse. Business justification: Individual beneficiaries collect assistance from assigned warehouses/distribution points. Critical for voucher programs, individual assistance, and beneficiary notification systems. Enables proximity-

attributes.name: age_years
attributes.description: Registrant's age in whole years at the time of registration. Stored explicitly to support age-band analytics and program eligibility checks when date_of_birth is estimated or unavailable. Derived from date_of_birth where known; otherwise entered directly.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; UNHCR Age and Gender Disaggregation Policy

attributes.name: completeness_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0–100) reflecting the completeness of the registrant's registration profile based on mandatory and recommended fields populated. Used for data quality monitoring, field staff performance tracking, and MEL data quality assessments.
attributes.references: IATI Data Quality Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; UNHCR Registration Quality Assurance Framework

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which informed consent was obtained from the registrant or their legal guardian. Required for GDPR compliance audit trails and CHS accountability reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: consent_given
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant (or legal guardian for minors) has provided informed consent for data collection, storage, and use per organizational data protection policy and applicable regulations. Mandatory for all registrations per CHS Commitment 4.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; GDPR Article 6; UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines; HAP Standard

attributes.name: country_of_origin_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code for the registrant's country of origin. Distinct from nationality for stateless persons and IDPs. Used for displacement tracking, protection analysis, and OCHA SitRep reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; UNHCR Refugee Status Determination Guidelines; OCHA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registrant record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Serves as the audit trail anchor for data lineage, GDPR data retention calculations, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation); FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: The registrant's date of birth in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for age calculation, vulnerability profiling, child protection flags, and eligibility determination for age-targeted programs (e.g., SAM/GAM nutrition screening, PSS services).
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4; Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards; UNICEF Child Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: deduplication_status
attributes.description: Current status of the deduplication check for this registrant record. 'Duplicate' records are suppressed from active program counts. 'Merged' indicates the record was consolidated with a master record. Supports USAID and DFID double-counting prevention requirements.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Beneficiary Deduplication Policy; WFP SCOPE Deduplication Standards; UNHCR proGres v4 Deduplication Module

attributes.name: disability_type
attributes.description: Classification of the registrant's disability type per Washington Group Short Set categories. Used for targeted accommodation planning, assistive device provision, and inclusive program design. Only populated when has_disability is True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobility|vision|hearing|cognitive|psychosocial|multiple|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Washington Group Short Set on Functioning; IASC Disability Inclusion Guidelines; WHO International Classification of Functioning (ICF)

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: The registrant's family name or surname as recorded at registration. Combined with given_name for full identity display and deduplication matching.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: The registrant's given name (first name) as recorded at registration. Used for identity verification, case management, and beneficiary communication.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: has_disability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant has a reported disability. Used for inclusive programming, accessibility accommodations, and Washington Group Short Set disaggregation in MEL reporting per IASC disability inclusion guidelines.
attributes.references: Washington Group Short Set on Functioning; IASC Disability Inclusion Guidelines; CRPD Article 11

attributes.name: is_gbv_survivor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant has been identified as a Gender-Based Violence (GBV) survivor. Triggers GBV case management referral, PSS services, and safe space access. Stored with highest data protection classification per GBV information management principles.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Guidelines; GBV Information Management System (GBVIMS) Standards; UNHCR GBV Data Protection Protocol

attributes.name: is_pregnant_or_lactating
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant is a pregnant or lactating woman (PLW). Triggers priority access to nutrition programs (SAM/GAM treatment, supplementary feeding), antenatal care referrals, and PLW-specific NFI kits.
attributes.references: Sphere Association Nutrition Standards; UNHCR Nutrition Guidelines; WHO Infant and Young Child Feeding Standards

attributes.name: is_unaccompanied_minor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant is an unaccompanied or separated child (UASC). Triggers child protection protocols, best-interest assessments, and mandatory referral to child protection case management per UNHCR/UNICEF UASC guidelines.
attributes.references: UNHCR/UNICEF Guidelines on Unaccompanied and Separated Children; CRC Article 20; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent identity or liveness verification for this registrant. Used to flag records requiring re-verification per program cycle requirements and to support active beneficiary count accuracy for donor reporting.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Beneficiary Verification Requirements; UNHCR Registration Quality Assurance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: muac_cm
attributes.description: Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) measurement in centimetres recorded at registration or nutrition screening. Used to classify acute malnutrition status (SAM: <11.5cm, MAM: 11.5–12.5cm) per Sphere/WHO nutrition protocols. Applicable for children 6–59 months and PLW.
attributes.references: WHO/UNICEF/WFP/UNHCR Joint Statement on Community-Based Management of Acute Malnutrition; Sphere Nutrition Standards; GAM/SAM Classification Thresholds

attributes.name: nationality_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the registrant's nationality. Used for protection status determination, IDP/refugee classification, and donor reporting disaggregation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; UNHCR proGres v4 Nationality Field; IATI Country Code Standard

attributes.name: poc_category
attributes.description: UNHCR-aligned classification of the registrant's protection status as a Person of Concern (PoC). Drives protection programming, legal aid eligibility, and UNHCR/OCHA statistical reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: refugee|idp|returnee|stateless|asylum_seeker|host_community|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UNHCR Statute; UNHCR proGres v4 PoC Category; OCHA Humanitarian Needs Overview Standards

attributes.name: preferred_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639 language code for the registrant's preferred communication language. Used to assign appropriate interpreters, translated materials, and language-appropriate PSS services. Supports CHS Commitment 4 on accessible communication.
attributes.references: ISO 639 Language Code Standard; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; HAP Communication Standards

attributes.name: protection_flag
attributes.description: Master protection concern flag indicating the registrant has one or more active protection risks (GBV, UASC, trafficking, detention risk, etc.). Triggers protection case management workflow and restricts data sharing per CHS data protection principles.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; UNHCR Protection Monitoring Guidelines; IASC Protection Cluster Standards

attributes.name: re_registration_count
attributes.description: Number of times this registrant has been re-registered in the system (e.g., after displacement, camp relocation, or annual verification cycles). Supports re-registration tracking and historical registration event analysis.
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration Guidelines; WFP SCOPE Re-registration Protocol; USAID BHA Beneficiary Verification Requirements

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the registrant was first formally registered into the beneficiary system. Used as the baseline date for program enrollment timelines, cohort analysis, and compliance reporting to donors (USAID BHA, DFID).
attributes.references: IATI Activity Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS Chapter 303

attributes.name: registration_modality
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the registrant was enrolled. Distinguishes in-person field registration, mobile data collection (KoboToolbox/CommCare), remote registration (phone/online), and self-registration kiosks. Informs data quality scoring and verification requirements.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards; CommCare Mobile Case Management; UNHCR Registration Guidelines

attributes.name: registration_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this registrant record originated. Supports data lineage, deduplication across systems, and interoperability mapping to UNHCR proGres v4, WFP SCOPE, and RAIS.
attributes.references: IATI Data Transparency Standard; CommCare Integration Specification; KoboToolbox API Documentation

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the registrant record. Controls eligibility for program services, NFI distributions, and case management workflows. 'Duplicate' status is set by the deduplication process; 'departed' indicates the individual has left the program area.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; UNHCR proGres v4 Case Status; CommCare Case Status

attributes.name: registration_tool
attributes.description: The specific data collection tool or form used to capture the registration. Distinguishes KoboToolbox survey forms, CommCare mobile case forms, paper-based forms, and direct system entry. Informs data quality and field validation rules.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards; CommCare Mobile Case Management; ICT4D Best Practices

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Classifies the registrant as an individual, household head, household member, or community-level registration. Determines the unit of analysis for program targeting, NFI distribution, and beneficiary counting methodologies.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Registration Type; WFP SCOPE Beneficiary Classification; Sphere Association Standards

attributes.name: sex
attributes.description: Biological sex of the registrant as recorded at registration. Used for DAC-compliant gender disaggregation in MEL reporting, GBV protection screening, and SPHERE-aligned needs assessments.
attributes.references: OECD DAC Gender Equality Marker; UNHCR Age and Gender Disaggregation Policy; IASC Gender Handbook

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., CommCare case_id, KoboToolbox submission UUID, proGres v4 individual_id). Enables bidirectional traceability and re-synchronization with operational systems.
attributes.references: CommCare Case Management API; KoboToolbox Submission API; UNHCR proGres v4 Data Dictionary

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this registrant record in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: verification_document_number
attributes.description: The document number from the identity verification document presented at registration (e.g., national ID number, passport number, UNHCR card number). Stored encrypted; used for deduplication and re-registration identity matching.
attributes.references: UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines; GDPR Article 9; USAID BHA Beneficiary Verification Requirements

attributes.name: verification_document_type
attributes.description: Type of identity verification document presented at registration. Used for identity assurance scoring, fraud prevention, and compliance with donor KYB (Know Your Beneficiary) requirements. 'Community attestation' applies where formal documents are unavailable.
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration Guidelines; USAID BHA Beneficiary Verification Requirements; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: vulnerability_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the registrant's vulnerability level derived from the vulnerability_score. Drives program targeting decisions, priority service access, and donor reporting on most-vulnerable population coverage.
attributes.references: UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework; OCHA Humanitarian Needs Overview; DAC Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: vulnerability_score
attributes.description: Composite vulnerability index score calculated from the needs assessment, capturing food insecurity, protection risks, health status, and displacement severity. Used for program prioritization, targeting, and MEL outcome tracking. Score range and methodology defined per program LogFrame.
attributes.references: UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework; WFP Vulnerability Analysis and Mapping (VAM); IASC Needs Assessment Standards

products.name: household
products.description: Master record for a household unit as the primary unit of registration and service delivery in humanitarian contexts. Captures household composition count, head-of-household reference (FK to registrant), geographic location, community/settlement reference, shelter type, displacement status, and household-level vulnerability indicators. Links individual registrants to their household grouping via household_member association for NFI distribution, WASH assessments, and food security programming. Supports WFP SCOPE household registration and UNHCR proGres family composition interoperability.
products.reference: UNHCR Household Registration / SPHERE Household Standards

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff or volunteer who conducted the household registration or most recent needs assessment. Used for data quality audits, enumerator performance tracking, and MEAL accountability reviews.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Form Metadata; CHS Commitment 5; HAP Standard

attributes.name: subaward_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.subaward. Business justification: Subaward compliance requires tracking how many households receive services under each subaward for financial accountability and monitoring. NGOs must verify subaward deliverables (households served) a

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse. Business justification: Households are assigned to specific warehouses/distribution points for assistance collection based on geographic proximity. Essential for last-mile distribution planning, beneficiary mobilization, and

attributes.name: admin1_name
attributes.description: Name of the first-level administrative division (region, province, or state) where the household is located. Aligns with OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs) administrative boundary layer 1 for GIS mapping and cluster reporting.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs); Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Admin Boundaries; IATI Location Standard

attributes.name: admin2_name
attributes.description: Name of the second-level administrative division (district, county, or department) where the household is located. Used for sub-national programme targeting, cluster coordination, and DHIS2 geographic disaggregation.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs); DHIS2 Organisation Unit Hierarchy; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap

attributes.name: children_under5_count
attributes.description: Number of children aged 0–4 years in the household. Critical for nutrition programme targeting (Global Acute Malnutrition / Severe Acute Malnutrition screening), UNICEF child protection reporting, and SPHERE minimum standards for child-specific NFI distributions.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; UNICEF Child Protection; WHO GAM/SAM Screening Protocols; DHIS2 Nutrition Indicators

attributes.name: commcare_case_reference
attributes.description: Unique case identifier from CommCare mobile case management system for this household. Enables bidirectional synchronisation between the lakehouse silver layer and CommCare for community health worker follow-up, beneficiary tracking, and case status updates.
attributes.references: CommCare Case Management API; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits Integration; CHS Commitment 5

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which informed consent was obtained from the head of household. Required for GDPR data processing records, CHS accountability documentation, and audit trails for data protection compliance reviews.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); CHS Commitment 4; HAP Standard; ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether informed consent for data collection and processing was obtained from the head of household at the time of registration. Mandatory for GDPR compliance, CHS Commitment 4 accountability, and HAP Standard data protection requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CHS Commitment 4; HAP Standard; ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the household's country of origin or habitual residence prior to displacement. Required for UNHCR refugee population statistics, OCHA Humanitarian Response Plan disaggregation, and IATI geographic coding.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; UNHCR Population Statistics; IATI Country Code Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the household record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data governance, GDPR data processing records, and silver layer lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing); FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Record Retention

attributes.name: current_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the household is currently residing. Used for cross-border programme coordination, OCHA SitRep geographic disaggregation, and IATI location reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI Location Standard; OCHA Common Operational Datasets

attributes.name: deregistration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the household exited or was closed from the programme. Nullable for active households. Used to calculate programme duration, exit analysis, and MEL outcome tracking. Corresponds to the effective-until date of the household registration agreement.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Case Closure; IATI Activity Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: displacement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the household was displaced from their place of habitual residence. Used for durable solutions planning, return and reintegration programming, and UNHCR proGres displacement history tracking.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Displacement History; Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement; OCHA IDP Monitoring

attributes.name: displacement_status
attributes.description: Classification of the household's displacement situation. Internally Displaced Person (IDP), refugee, returnee, host community, stateless, or asylum seeker. Determines eligibility for specific UNHCR, OCHA, and WFP programme streams and drives proGres v4 population group assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: idp|refugee|returnee|host_community|stateless|asylum_seeker — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UNHCR Refugee Status Determination; OCHA IDP Tracking; 1951 Refugee Convention; Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement

attributes.name: elderly_count
attributes.description: Number of household members aged 60 years or older. Used for vulnerability scoring, priority targeting in food security and health programmes, and age-disaggregated donor reporting per OCHA and IASC standards.
attributes.references: IASC Age and Disability Disaggregation; OCHA Humanitarian Response Plan; HelpAge International Standards

attributes.name: exit_reason
attributes.description: Reason for the household's exit or closure from the programme. Used for MEL outcome analysis, durable solutions tracking, and donor reporting on programme completion rates. Nullable for active households. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: graduated|relocated|deceased|voluntary_withdrawal|ineligible|duplicate|lost_to_followup — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UNHCR Durable Solutions Framework; WFP Programme Exit Strategy; USAID BHA Closeout Guidelines; CHS Commitment 6

attributes.name: female_count
attributes.description: Number of female individuals in the household. Required for sex-disaggregated reporting to OCHA, USAID, and DFID donors. Supports gender analysis in MEL frameworks and IASC gender marker compliance.
attributes.references: IASC Gender Marker; OCHA Humanitarian Response Plan; USAID ADS 205 Gender Equality

attributes.name: food_security_status
attributes.description: Household-level food security classification based on the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) or Household Food Insecurity Access Scale (HFIAS). Drives WFP food assistance targeting, cash transfer programme eligibility, and OCHA food security cluster reporting.
attributes.references: IPC Global Partners Food Security Classification; WFP SCOPE Food Security; FEWS NET; OCHA Food Security Cluster

attributes.name: gbv_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has been identified as at elevated risk of or affected by Gender-Based Violence (GBV). Classified restricted due to sensitivity. Triggers referral to GBV case management, PSS (Psychosocial Support) services, and safe space programming. Access strictly controlled per GBV information management protocols.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Guidelines; GBV Information Management System (GBVIMS); UNHCR GBV Standard Operating Procedures; CHS Commitment 3

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the household's physical location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Captured via KoboToolbox GPS widget during field registration. Used for GIS mapping, proximity analysis, and Humanitarian OpenStreetMap integration. Classified confidential as precise location of vulnerable individuals.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap; KoboToolbox GPS Standard; OCHA GIS Guidelines

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the household's physical location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Captured via KoboToolbox GPS widget during field registration. Used for GIS mapping, proximity analysis, and Humanitarian OpenStreetMap integration. Classified confidential as precise location of vulnerable individuals.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap; KoboToolbox GPS Standard; OCHA GIS Guidelines

attributes.name: has_pregnant_lactating
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pregnant or Lactating Woman Present Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household includes at least one pregnant or lactating woman (PLW). Critical flag for nutrition programme targeting (supplementary feeding, micronutrient supplementation), SPHERE nutrition standards compliance, and UNICEF/WFP PLW-specific assistance eligibility.
attributes.references: SPHERE Nutrition Standards; UNICEF PLW Nutrition Guidelines; WFP SCOPE Nutrition Targeting

attributes.name: has_unaccompanied_minor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Unaccompanied or Separated Child (UASC) Present Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household includes an unaccompanied or separated child (UASC). Triggers child protection case management protocols in CommCare, UNHCR UASC registration procedures, and UNICEF child protection programme referrals.
attributes.references: UNHCR UASC Guidelines; UNICEF Child Protection; IASC Child Protection Minimum Standards; CRC Article 20

attributes.name: is_female_headed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household is headed by a woman. Key targeting criterion for GBV (Gender-Based Violence) prevention programmes, women's economic empowerment initiatives, and IASC gender marker reporting. Required for USAID gender equality disaggregation.
attributes.references: IASC Gender Marker; USAID ADS 205 Gender Equality; UN Women Programming Principles; OCHA Gender in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: kobo_submission_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the KoboToolbox form submission that created or last updated this household record. Enables traceability back to the original field data collection form for data quality audits, MEAL verification, and source system reconciliation.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Form Submission Metadata; OCHA Field Data Collection Standards; CHS Commitment 5 Data Quality

attributes.name: last_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent household-level needs assessment or vulnerability re-assessment conducted. Used to identify households overdue for reassessment, track MEL data currency, and ensure programme targeting reflects current conditions per MEAL cycle requirements.
attributes.references: OCHA Needs Assessment Framework; IASC Needs Assessment Task Force; CHS Commitment 5; USAID MEL Policy

attributes.name: male_count
attributes.description: Number of male individuals in the household. Required for sex-disaggregated reporting to OCHA, USAID, and DFID donors. Supports gender analysis in MEL frameworks and IASC gender marker compliance.
attributes.references: IASC Gender Marker; OCHA Humanitarian Response Plan; USAID ADS 205 Gender Equality

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for field staff to record contextual observations, special circumstances, or case management notes about the household that do not fit structured fields. Classified confidential due to potential sensitivity of recorded information. Supports CommCare case notes and KoboToolbox open-text responses.
attributes.references: CHS Commitment 4 (Accountability); HAP Standard; ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: pwd_count
attributes.description: Number of household members with a physical, sensory, intellectual, or psychosocial disability. Required for IASC disability inclusion reporting, Washington Group Short Set disaggregation, and inclusive programming compliance under the CRPD.
attributes.references: IASC Guidelines on Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities; Washington Group Short Set on Functioning; UN CRPD

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the household was first formally registered into the programme. Serves as the effective start date of the household agreement with the organisation. Used for cohort analysis, programme duration calculations, and donor reporting.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4; WFP SCOPE; IATI Activity Standard

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the household at point of registration. Used across field operations, NFI distribution lists, WASH assessments, and food security programming as the primary cross-system reference. Corresponds to the SCOPE household token or proGres case number.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4; WFP SCOPE; IATI Beneficiary Identifier Standard

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the household registration. Active indicates the household is enrolled and eligible for services. Suspended indicates a temporary hold pending verification. Closed indicates the household has exited programming. Drives eligibility checks in CommCare and Microsoft Dynamics 365 case management.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Case Status; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 1; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Classification of the registration event that created or last updated this household record. Distinguishes initial intake from periodic re-verification exercises required by UNHCR and WFP programme cycles.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Registration Type Codes; CHS Commitment 4

attributes.name: sanitation_facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the household's primary sanitation facility. Core WASH indicator for SPHERE minimum standards, OCHA WASH cluster reporting, and WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) SDG 6 tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flush_toilet|pit_latrine|ventilated_pit|open_defecation|communal_latrine|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SPHERE WASH Standards; WHO/UNICEF JMP SDG 6; OCHA WASH Cluster; DHIS2 WASH Indicators

attributes.name: shelter_ownership
attributes.description: Tenure status of the household's current shelter. Distinguishes owned, rented, informal/squatter, organisation-provided, or communal arrangements. Used for durable solutions planning, land rights programming, and UNHCR shelter vulnerability assessments.
attributes.references: UNHCR Shelter Assessment Framework; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; UN-Habitat Land Tenure Guidelines

attributes.name: shelter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the household's current shelter situation. Used for SPHERE shelter standard compliance assessments, NFI kit targeting (shelter kits vs. core relief items), and OCHA shelter cluster reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: permanent|semi-permanent|temporary|makeshift|collective_centre|host_family|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Standards Chapter 4 (Shelter); OCHA Shelter Cluster; UNHCR Shelter Assessment Framework

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Total count of individuals residing in the household at the time of last registration or update. Used for NFI distribution quantity calculations, food ration sizing, WASH facility planning, and WFP SCOPE entitlement computation.
attributes.references: WFP SCOPE Household Composition; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; UNHCR proGres v4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the household record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: vulnerability_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of household vulnerability derived from the vulnerability score or direct assessment. Used for programme targeting tiers, priority service delivery sequencing, and donor reporting on most-vulnerable population reach.
attributes.references: UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework; WFP VAM; CHS Commitment 1; USAID BHA Targeting Guidelines

attributes.name: vulnerability_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score representing the household's overall vulnerability level, calculated from a standardised vulnerability assessment tool (e.g., Proxy Means Test, Household Economy Analysis). Used for priority targeting, programme tiering, and MEL outcome baseline establishment. Score range and methodology defined per programme.
attributes.references: UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework; WFP Vulnerability Analysis and Mapping (VAM); USAID Resilience Framework

attributes.name: water_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the household's primary drinking water source. Core WASH (Water, Sanitation and Hygiene) indicator required for SPHERE minimum standards compliance, OCHA WASH cluster reporting, and DHIS2 WASH indicator tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: piped|borehole|protected_spring|unprotected_spring|surface_water|trucked|rainwater — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SPHERE WASH Standards; WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP); OCHA WASH Cluster; DHIS2 WASH Indicators

products.name: household_member
products.description: Association entity linking an individual registrant to their household. Captures role (head, spouse, child, dependent, elderly), relationship to head-of-household, membership start/end dates, and demographic attributes relevant to household composition analysis. Enables NFI distribution sizing, dependency ratio calculations, and vulnerability scoring at household level.
products.reference: UNHCR Household Composition / CommCare Household Member

attributes.name: household_member_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each household member association record in the beneficiary domain. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Beneficiary Data Management

attributes.name: case_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CommCare or Microsoft Dynamics 365 case management record associated with this household member. Used for case follow-up, service delivery tracking, and MEL (Monitoring Evaluation and Learning) outcome measurement.
attributes.references: CommCare — Mobile Case Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Case Management

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household to which this individual belongs. Links the member record to the household registration unit for NFI distribution sizing and vulnerability scoring.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Charter and Minimum Standards — Household Registration

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.intervention. Business justification: NGO program reach reporting requires tracking which intervention each household member is enrolled in. Disaggregated beneficiary counts (by sex, age, disability) per intervention are mandatory for don

attributes.name: registrant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual beneficiary registration record for this household member. Links to the beneficiary master record captured in CommCare or KoboToolbox.
attributes.references: CommCare — Case Management; KoboToolbox — Beneficiary Registration

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the field enumerator or data collector who registered this household member. Used for data quality audits, enumerator performance monitoring, and traceability of field data in KoboToolbox and CommCare.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards; CommCare — Community Health Worker Tracking

attributes.name: age_estimated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recorded age or date of birth is an estimate rather than a verified value. Common in humanitarian field contexts where documentation is unavailable. Affects data quality scoring for MEL reporting.
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration Guidelines; KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards

attributes.name: age_years
attributes.description: Recorded or estimated age of the household member in years at time of registration. Used when exact date of birth is unknown, which is common in humanitarian contexts. Supports age-band disaggregation for NFI sizing and program targeting.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Charter — Age Disaggregation; UNHCR Registration Guidelines

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which informed consent was obtained from this household member or their legal guardian. Required for GDPR compliance audit trails and CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard) accountability reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standards

attributes.name: consent_given
attributes.description: Indicates whether this household member (or their guardian) has provided informed consent for data collection, storage, and use in program delivery. Mandatory per CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard) and GDPR data protection requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 and 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Commitment 4; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standards

attributes.name: consent_withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which this household member or their guardian withdrew consent for data processing. Triggers data anonymisation or deletion workflows per GDPR Article 17 right to erasure.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 and 17; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: country_of_origin_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code for the country from which the household member originates. Distinct from nationality; used for refugee and IDP classification, UNHCR PoC (Person of Concern) reporting, and cross-border displacement analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; UNHCR Refugee Status Determination; OCHA Displacement Tracking

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this household member association record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails, data lineage, and MEL (Monitoring Evaluation and Learning) data quality reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: Method used to collect this household member's registration data. FGD (Focus Group Discussion), KII (Key Informant Interview), KoboToolbox survey, or CommCare mobile form. Used for data quality assessment and MEL methodology documentation.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards; CommCare Mobile Case Management; MEAL (Monitoring Evaluation Accountability and Learning) Methodology

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the household member. Used to calculate age for program eligibility (e.g., child nutrition programs, elderly support), dependency ratio, and demographic disaggregation in MEL reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; UNHCR Age and Gender Disaggregation Policy; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: disability_status
attributes.description: Recorded disability classification for the household member using the Washington Group Short Set framework. Used for inclusive programming, NFI adaptation, and SPHERE accessibility compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|physical|sensory|cognitive|psychosocial|multiple|prefer_not_to_say — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Washington Group on Disability Statistics; SPHERE Humanitarian Charter — Inclusion; CRPD (Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities)

attributes.name: displacement_status
attributes.description: Classification of the household member's displacement situation. IDP (Internally Displaced Person), refugee, returnee, or host community member. Drives program eligibility, UNHCR PoC (Person of Concern) reporting, and OCHA SitRep (Situation Report) disaggregation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: idp|refugee|returnee|host_community|stateless|asylum_seeker|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UNHCR Refugee Status Determination Guidelines; OCHA Displacement Tracking Matrix; IASC Durable Solutions Framework

attributes.name: education_level
attributes.description: Highest level of education attained by this household member. Used for livelihood program targeting, literacy-based service adaptation, and SDG (Sustainable Development Goal) 4 education indicator reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|primary_incomplete|primary_complete|secondary_incomplete|secondary_complete|tertiary|vocational|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISCED (International Standard Classification of Education); SDG Goal 4; USAID Education Policy

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: Surname or family name of the household member as recorded during beneficiary registration. Combined with given_name for full identity verification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: gender_identity
attributes.description: Self-identified gender of the household member, captured where programmatically relevant (e.g., GBV programs, PSS (Psychosocial Support) services). Distinct from biological sex. Collected only with informed consent per data protection standards.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; IASC Gender Handbook; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: First or given name of the household member as recorded during beneficiary registration. Used for identity verification during distributions and case management follow-up.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines; IRS 501(c)(3) Beneficiary Records

attributes.name: is_female_headed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this member is the head of a female-headed household. Used for gender-disaggregated reporting, targeted programming for female-headed households, and DAC (Development Assistance Committee) gender marker compliance.
attributes.references: DAC Gender Equality Marker; IASC Gender Handbook; SPHERE Humanitarian Charter

attributes.name: is_head_of_household
attributes.description: Indicates whether this member is the designated head of household. Only one member per household should have this flag set to true. Used for primary contact identification, distribution authorization, and household-level reporting.
attributes.references: UNHCR Household Registration Guidelines; SPHERE Humanitarian Charter

attributes.name: livelihood_status
attributes.description: Current livelihood or employment status of the household member. Used for economic vulnerability assessment, cash transfer program eligibility, and livelihoods program targeting.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Charter — Livelihoods; USAID BHA Economic Recovery Standards; SDG Goal 8

attributes.name: member_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this household member association, used in field operations, PDM (Post-Distribution Monitoring) forms, and inter-agency data sharing.
attributes.references: IATI — International Aid Transparency Initiative; OCHA — Beneficiary Tracking Standards

attributes.name: member_role
attributes.description: Functional role of this individual within the household structure, used for program targeting, NFI kit sizing, and household vulnerability profiling. Distinct from relationship_to_head which captures kinship; this captures programmatic classification.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Charter — Household Composition; OCHA Cluster Coordination

attributes.name: membership_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this individual's membership in the household ended, due to departure, transfer, death, or administrative closure. Null if membership is currently active.
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration Guidelines; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: membership_end_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why this individual's household membership ended. Required for attrition analysis, household composition tracking, and MEL (Monitoring Evaluation and Learning) reporting.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; OCHA Beneficiary Tracking

attributes.name: membership_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this individual formally joined or was registered as a member of the household. Used to determine eligibility windows for program benefits and historical household composition analysis.
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration Guidelines; SPHERE Humanitarian Charter

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this individual's membership in the household. Drives eligibility for household-level distributions and services. 'transferred' indicates movement to another household; 'departed' indicates voluntary exit.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Beneficiary Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: muac_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the MUAC (Mid-Upper Arm Circumference) measurement was recorded for this household member. Used to determine recency of nutritional screening and trigger follow-up assessments per SPHERE protocols.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Charter — Nutrition; WHO MUAC Screening Protocols

attributes.name: muac_cm
attributes.description: MUAC (Mid-Upper Arm Circumference) measurement in centimetres recorded for this household member. Primary screening indicator for acute malnutrition (SAM/GAM). Values below 11.5cm indicate SAM (Severe Acute Malnutrition); 11.5–12.5cm indicate MAM (Moderate Acute Malnutrition).
attributes.references: WHO MUAC Standards; SPHERE Humanitarian Charter — Nutrition; USAID BHA GAM/SAM Thresholds; UNICEF Nutrition Protocols

attributes.name: nationality_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the nationality of the household member. Used for IDP (Internally Displaced Person) and PoC (Person of Concern) classification, cross-border program eligibility, and UNHCR reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; UNHCR Registration Guidelines; OCHA Beneficiary Tracking

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for field staff to record additional observations, special circumstances, or case notes relevant to this household member's situation. Classified as confidential due to potential sensitivity of recorded information.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Data Protection; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: pregnant_or_lactating
attributes.description: Indicates whether this household member is currently pregnant or lactating. Used for nutrition program targeting (e.g., SAM/GAM treatment), supplementary feeding eligibility, and SPHERE maternal health standards compliance.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Charter — Nutrition; WHO Infant and Young Child Feeding Guidelines; USAID BHA Nutrition Standards

attributes.name: primary_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code for the primary language spoken by this household member. Used for communication planning, interpreter assignment, and ensuring informed consent is obtained in the member's language per CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard).
attributes.references: ISO 639-1/639-2; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Communication and Accountability

attributes.name: protection_concern_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this household member has an active protection concern (e.g., GBV risk, child protection issue, trafficking risk). Triggers case escalation in CommCare and referral to protection cluster. Stored as restricted due to sensitivity.
attributes.references: IASC Protection Cluster Guidelines; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; UNHCR Protection Framework

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this household member was formally registered in the beneficiary management system (CommCare or KoboToolbox). Establishes the start of the individual's program eligibility timeline.
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration Guidelines; KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards; CommCare Case Management

attributes.name: registration_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic location (camp, settlement, community, or administrative unit) where this household member was registered. Used for geographic disaggregation in MEL reporting and GIS (Geographic Information System) mapping.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets — Administrative Boundaries; IATI Geographic Coding Standards

attributes.name: relationship_to_head
attributes.description: Describes the kinship or social relationship of this member to the designated head of household. Used for dependency ratio calculations, vulnerability scoring, and NFI distribution entitlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: head|spouse|child|parent|sibling|dependent|other_relative|non_relative — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Charter — Household Composition Standards; UNHCR Household Registration Guidelines

attributes.name: school_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current school enrollment status for household members of school age. Used for education program targeting, out-of-school children identification, and SDG 4 indicator tracking in DHIS2.
attributes.references: SDG Goal 4; UNICEF Education in Emergencies Standards; USAID Education Policy

attributes.name: sex
attributes.description: Biological sex of the household member as recorded at registration. Used for gender disaggregation in MEL reporting, GBV (Gender-Based Violence) program targeting, and SPHERE/DAC (Development Assistance Committee) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Charter; DAC Gender Equality Marker; IASC Gender Handbook; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: unaccompanied_minor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this household member is an unaccompanied or separated child (UASC). Triggers child protection protocols, case management escalation in CommCare, and mandatory reporting to child protection clusters.
attributes.references: IASC Guidelines on Unaccompanied and Separated Children; CRC (Convention on the Rights of the Child); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this household member association record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronisation between CommCare/KoboToolbox and the lakehouse, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the identity and eligibility verification was completed for this household member. Used for audit trails and determining when re-verification is due.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; UNHCR Registration and Identity Management

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of identity and eligibility verification for this household member. 'verified' indicates documentation has been reviewed and confirmed; 'rejected' indicates the member failed verification and is ineligible for program benefits.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Accountability; UNHCR Registration and Identity Management

attributes.name: vulnerability_category
attributes.description: Primary vulnerability classification for this household member, used for program targeting, priority distribution, and MEL (Monitoring Evaluation and Learning) disaggregation. GBV (Gender-Based Violence) survivors and unaccompanied minors receive heightened protection protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: child_under_5|unaccompanied_minor|pregnant_lactating|elderly|gbv_survivor|disability|chronic_illness|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Charter — Vulnerability; IASC Protection Cluster; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

products.name: vulnerability_profile
products.description: Structured vulnerability assessment record for a registrant or household capturing multi-dimensional vulnerability indicators including food insecurity score (IPC phase classification), protection risk level, disability classification (Washington Group questions), chronic illness flags, GAM/SAM nutritional status (MUAC measurement), GBV exposure flag, displacement category (IDP, refugee, returnee), and composite vulnerability score used for program targeting and prioritization. Distinct from needs_assessment which captures point-in-time sector-specific assessment findings — vulnerability_profile represents the beneficiary's current consolidated vulnerability state derived from multiple assessment inputs. Updated when new assessment data materially changes vulnerability classification.
products.reference: UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework / SPHERE Vulnerability Criteria

attributes.name: vulnerability_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the vulnerability profile record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Beneficiary Data Management

attributes.name: assessing_volunteer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to volunteer.volunteer. Business justification: Vulnerability assessment quality assurance: trained volunteers (community health volunteers, enumerators) conduct vulnerability assessments. Tracking the assessing volunteer per profile is required fo

attributes.name: community_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to beneficiary.community. Business justification: Vulnerability profiles in humanitarian programs are conducted not only for individuals and households but also at the community level (e.g., community vulnerability assessments for IPC phase classific

attributes.name: donor_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.donor_requirement. Business justification: Vulnerability assessment methodologies and scoring criteria are mandated by donor requirements (WFP VAM methodology, UNHCR vulnerability criteria, ECHO targeting standards). Linking vulnerability_prof

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household unit associated with this vulnerability profile. Enables household-level aggregation and targeting for program interventions.
attributes.references: UNHCR Household Registration Guidelines; KoboToolbox Household Survey Module

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary humanitarian or development program under which this vulnerability profile was generated or is being used for targeting. Links the profile to program-specific eligibility criteria and Theory of Change (ToC) outcomes.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Program Management Module; IATI Activity Standard

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Vulnerability profiles are assessed and owned by field org units. Aggregate vulnerability reporting by org unit (country office, field team) is a standard NGO program management and donor reporting re

attributes.name: previous_profile_vulnerability_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding vulnerability profile record for this registrant, enabling longitudinal tracking of vulnerability changes over time. Populated when profile_status is 'superseded' or when a new profile replaces an existing one.
attributes.references: IATI Data Standard — Activity History; CommCare Case History

attributes.name: registrant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual beneficiary or household head registered in the beneficiary registry. Links this vulnerability profile to the specific Person of Concern (PoC) or Internally Displaced Person (IDP) record.
attributes.references: UNHCR Beneficiary Registration Standards; CommCare Case Management

attributes.name: reporting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mel.reporting_period. Business justification: Periodic vulnerability reassessment tracking: Vulnerability profiles are reassessed at MEL-defined intervals (baseline, midline, endline). Linking to reporting_period enables MEL teams to identify whi

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member or field worker who conducted the vulnerability assessment. Used for quality assurance, accountability, and inter-rater reliability analysis in MEL processes.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Accountability to Affected Populations; HAP Standards

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent vulnerability assessment was conducted that materially changed or established this profile. Used for timeliness tracking and MEL reporting cycles.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; OCHA Needs Assessment Guidelines

attributes.name: children_under5_count
attributes.description: Number of children under 5 years of age in the household. Children under 5 are the primary target group for acute malnutrition screening (MUAC), vaccination campaigns, and early childhood development programs. Used for nutrition and child protection program sizing.
attributes.references: UNICEF Child Nutrition Standards; SPHERE Nutrition Standards; SMART Methodology

attributes.name: chronic_illness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary has one or more documented chronic illnesses (e.g., HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, diabetes, hypertension) that increase vulnerability and require sustained health service access. Drives health program targeting and DHIS2 health indicator reporting.
attributes.references: WHO International Classification of Diseases (ICD-11); DHIS2 Health Program Monitoring

attributes.name: chronic_illness_type
attributes.description: Coded description of the primary chronic illness condition affecting the beneficiary (e.g., HIV_AIDS, tuberculosis, diabetes, hypertension, malnutrition_chronic). Populated only when chronic_illness_flag is True. Aligned with ICD-11 coding where applicable.
attributes.references: WHO ICD-11; DHIS2 Health Program Monitoring; PEPFAR Reporting Standards

attributes.name: composite_vulnerability_score
attributes.description: Aggregated multi-dimensional vulnerability score derived from weighted combination of food insecurity (IPC phase), protection risk, disability, nutritional status, displacement category, and other assessed indicators. Used for program targeting, beneficiary prioritization, and Results-Based Management (RBM) reporting. Score range typically 0.00–100.00.
attributes.references: OCHA Humanitarian Needs Overview (HNO) Methodology; IASC Needs Assessment Framework; RBM Standards

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which informed consent was obtained from the beneficiary or their legal guardian. Required for data protection compliance and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: consent_obtained_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether informed consent was obtained from the beneficiary or their legal guardian prior to data collection and vulnerability profiling. Mandatory for compliance with data protection regulations and CHS accountability standards.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; GDPR Article 6; ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the beneficiary is located. Used for multi-country program management, IATI reporting, and donor country-level disaggregation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI Data Standard; OCHA ReliefWeb

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary has consented to their vulnerability data being shared with partner organizations and inter-agency coordination bodies (e.g., UNHCR, OCHA clusters). Governs data sharing under inter-agency data sharing agreements.
attributes.references: ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action; OCHA Data Responsibility Guidelines; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: disability_classification
attributes.description: Functional difficulty domain identified using the Washington Group Short Set on Functioning (WG-SS) questions. Captures the primary domain of disability: seeing, hearing, mobility, cognition, self-care, or communication. Used for inclusive programming and disability-disaggregated reporting per CRPD. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|seeing|hearing|mobility|cognition|self_care|communication|multiple — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Washington Group on Disability Statistics (WG-SS); UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD); IASC Disability Inclusion Guidelines

attributes.name: disability_severity
attributes.description: Severity of functional difficulty as measured by the Washington Group Short Set (WG-SS) response scale: no difficulty, some difficulty, a lot of difficulty, or cannot do at all. Used alongside disability_classification for disaggregated disability reporting.
attributes.references: Washington Group on Disability Statistics (WG-SS); UN CRPD

attributes.name: displacement_category
attributes.description: Classification of the beneficiary's displacement status per UNHCR definitions. Internally Displaced Person (IDP) refers to those displaced within their country; refugee refers to those who have crossed international borders; returnee refers to those who have returned to their place of origin. Drives program eligibility and UNHCR/OCHA reporting.
attributes.references: UNHCR Refugee Status Determination Guidelines; OCHA IDP Tracking Matrix (DTM)

attributes.name: elderly_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household includes one or more elderly members (typically aged 60+). Elderly individuals are a recognized vulnerable group requiring targeted assistance per SPHERE and IASC age and disability inclusion guidelines.
attributes.references: SPHERE Standards; IASC Age and Disability Inclusion Guidelines; HelpAge International Standards

attributes.name: female_headed_household_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household is headed by a woman. Female-headed households are recognized as a priority vulnerability category in humanitarian programming due to heightened protection risks and reduced access to resources. Used for gender-disaggregated reporting.
attributes.references: IASC Gender Handbook; USAID Gender Equality Policy; SDG 5 (Gender Equality)

attributes.name: gbv_exposure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary has been identified as a survivor or at-risk individual for Gender-Based Violence (GBV). Triggers referral to GBV case management services and specialized support programs. Handled with strict confidentiality per GBV information management protocols.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Guidelines; UNFPA GBV Information Management System (GBVIMS); CHS Alliance

attributes.name: geographic_area_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the geographic area (admin level 2 or 3) where the beneficiary is located at the time of assessment. Used for geographic targeting, GIS mapping, and OCHA cluster reporting. Aligned with OCHA Common Operational Datasets (COD) administrative boundary codes.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (COD); GADM Administrative Boundaries; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap

attributes.name: ipc_phase
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) Phase
attributes.description: Food insecurity severity classification using the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) scale: 1=Minimal, 2=Stressed, 3=Crisis, 4=Emergency, 5=Famine/Catastrophe. Used for food assistance targeting and donor reporting to BHA/USAID.
attributes.references: IPC Global Partners — IPC Technical Manual v3.1; FEWS NET

attributes.name: livelihood_status
attributes.description: Assessment of the beneficiary household's livelihood and income-generating capacity. 'none' indicates complete loss of livelihood; 'disrupted' indicates significant reduction; 'partial' indicates some income sources remain; 'stable' indicates adequate livelihood. Used for cash and voucher assistance (CVA) targeting.
attributes.references: SEEP Network Livelihoods Assessment Framework; USAID BHA Livelihoods Programming

attributes.name: muac_mm
attributes.description: Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) measurement in millimetres, used as the primary anthropometric indicator for acute malnutrition screening in children under 5 and pregnant/lactating women. Thresholds: <115mm = SAM, 115–124mm = MAM, ≥125mm = normal. Collected via KoboToolbox or CommCare field surveys.
attributes.references: WHO MUAC Measurement Protocol; SPHERE Nutrition Standards; SMART Methodology

attributes.name: next_reassessment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next vulnerability reassessment to ensure the profile reflects the beneficiary's current vulnerability state. Drives field operations scheduling and MEL monitoring cycles. Typically set based on program-specific reassessment frequency protocols.
attributes.references: SPHERE Standards; IASC Needs Assessment Framework; MEAL Framework

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for field officers to record contextual observations, qualitative vulnerability factors, or case-specific notes that are not captured by structured indicators. Handled as confidential due to potential sensitivity of content.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; CommCare Case Notes

attributes.name: nutritional_status
attributes.description: Nutritional status classification based on anthropometric screening. Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) indicates MUAC < 115mm or WHZ < -3; Moderate Acute Malnutrition (MAM) indicates MUAC 115–124mm or WHZ -2 to -3; normal indicates adequate nutritional status. Used for therapeutic feeding program targeting and Global Acute Malnutrition (GAM) rate reporting.
attributes.references: WHO/UNICEF/WFP/UNHCR Joint Statement on SAM; SPHERE Nutrition Standards; SMART Methodology

attributes.name: pregnant_lactating_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household includes a pregnant or lactating woman (PLW). PLWs are a priority group for nutrition programming (supplementary feeding), antenatal care, and maternal health services. Used for CMAM and nutrition program targeting.
attributes.references: WHO Nutrition Guidelines for PLW; SPHERE Nutrition Standards; UNICEF CMAM Protocol

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this vulnerability profile record, used in field operations, donor reporting, and inter-agency data sharing (e.g., VP-SOM-000123456).
attributes.references: IATI Data Standard; OCHA Common Operational Datasets

attributes.name: profile_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vulnerability profile record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: IATI Data Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: profile_source
attributes.description: Indicates the operational process or event that triggered the creation or update of this vulnerability profile. 'post_distribution_monitoring' refers to Post-Distribution Monitoring (PDM) assessments; 'emergency_screening' refers to rapid assessments during acute crises. Used for MEL data quality analysis.
attributes.references: OCHA Needs Assessment Guidelines; IASC Operational Guidance on PDM; MEAL Framework

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vulnerability profile record. 'active' indicates the current consolidated vulnerability state; 'superseded' indicates a newer profile has replaced this one; 'pending_review' indicates awaiting validation by a protection or MEL officer.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; CommCare Case Status Lifecycle

attributes.name: profile_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vulnerability profile was last modified, reflecting the most recent update to any vulnerability indicator. Triggers downstream re-targeting and prioritization workflows.
attributes.references: IATI Data Standard; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: protection_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed level of protection risk for the individual or household, encompassing threats of violence, exploitation, abuse, and discrimination. Classified by a trained protection officer. Drives case prioritization and referral pathways per UNHCR Protection Framework.
attributes.references: UNHCR Protection Framework; IASC Protection Cluster Guidelines; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: pss_need_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary has been assessed as requiring Psychosocial Support (PSS) services, including mental health support, trauma counselling, or community-based psychosocial activities. Triggers referral to PSS programming.
attributes.references: IASC Guidelines on Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS); WHO mhGAP

attributes.name: shelter_adequacy
attributes.description: Assessment of the beneficiary's shelter situation against SPHERE minimum standards. 'none' indicates no shelter; 'inadequate' indicates shelter below minimum standards; 'transitional' indicates temporary/emergency shelter; 'adequate' indicates shelter meeting minimum standards. Drives NFI and shelter program targeting.
attributes.references: SPHERE Shelter and Settlement Standards; UNHCR Shelter Guidelines

attributes.name: unaccompanied_minor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary is an unaccompanied or separated child (UASC) — a child under 18 separated from both parents and other relatives and not being cared for by a responsible adult. Triggers child protection case management and family tracing and reunification (FTR) services.
attributes.references: UNHCR/UNICEF Guidelines on Unaccompanied and Separated Children; CRC Article 20; IASC Child Protection

attributes.name: vulnerability_tier
attributes.description: Categorical tier derived from the composite vulnerability score, used for operational targeting and prioritization decisions. 'critical' indicates immediate life-saving intervention required; 'high' indicates priority program enrollment; 'medium' and 'low' indicate standard program eligibility. Distinct from composite_vulnerability_score which is the numeric value.
attributes.references: OCHA HNO Severity Classification; IASC Needs Assessment Framework

attributes.name: wash_access_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) Access Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary household has adequate access to safe water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) facilities meeting SPHERE minimum standards. False indicates a WASH vulnerability requiring intervention. Used for WASH sector targeting and OCHA cluster reporting.
attributes.references: SPHERE WASH Standards; UNICEF/WHO Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP); OCHA WASH Cluster

products.name: needs_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of a formal needs assessment conducted for an individual beneficiary, household, or community to determine eligibility, vulnerability level, and appropriate service referrals. Captures assessment date, assessment level (individual, household, community), assessment type (initial registration assessment, periodic reassessment, post-crisis rapid assessment, sector-specific deep assessment), sectors assessed (WASH, nutrition, shelter, protection, livelihoods, education), assessment tool identifier (KoboToolbox form ID, CommCare module), field enumerator, geographic coordinates, and scored findings per sector. Owned by beneficiary domain as it determines beneficiary status and targeting — distinct from MEL post-distribution monitoring which measures program effectiveness. Assessment findings feed into vulnerability_profile updates when they materially change vulnerability classification.
products.reference: KoboToolbox Needs Assessment / OCHA Humanitarian Needs Overview (HNO)

attributes.name: needs_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each needs assessment record. Primary key for the needs_assessment data product within the beneficiary domain.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Data Management Principles

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.partnership_agreement. Business justification: Needs assessments are funded and scoped under specific partnership agreements; donor reporting requires attributing assessment coverage and methodology to the governing agreement. Partner performance

attributes.name: assessor_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Needs assessments are conducted by staff in specific positions (Nutrition Officer, Protection Officer, WASH Engineer). Linking to position enables assessment quality analysis by position type and staf

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.commodity. Business justification: Needs assessments identify specific commodity requirements (NFI kits, food baskets, WASH items, shelter materials) for beneficiaries. Essential for humanitarian needs-based procurement planning and Sp

attributes.name: community_id
attributes.description: Reference to the community or settlement unit that is the subject of this assessment when assessment_level is 'community'. Nullable when assessment_level is 'individual' or 'household'.
