attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets — Settlement/Community Registry

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.component. Business justification: Needs assessments in NGOs are commissioned by specific program components to inform component-level design and targeting decisions. Component-level aggregation of assessment findings is required for c

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.corrective_action_plan. Business justification: When internal reviews or audits identify needs assessment quality issues (sampling bias, incomplete data, targeting errors), corrective action plans document remediation measures. Essential for qualit

attributes.name: data_collection_tool_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the data collection instrument used to conduct this assessment. For KoboToolbox, this is the form UID (e.g., 'aXmK3p9QrT'). For CommCare, this is the module ID. Enables traceability back to the specific questionnaire version and supports data quality audits.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Form Management — Form UID; CommCare Application Builder — Module ID

attributes.name: donor_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.donor_requirement. Business justification: Needs assessments are frequently mandated by specific donor requirements (baseline assessments before program start, specific assessment tools, minimum sample sizes). Linking to donor_requirement enab

attributes.name: emergency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.emergency. Business justification: Needs assessments are triggered by and scoped to specific emergencies (e.g., flood rapid assessment). Linking to emergency enables flash appeal and HRP needs analysis by emergency. No existing emergen

attributes.name: enumerator_volunteer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to volunteer.volunteer. Business justification: Volunteers conduct needs assessments in many NGO operations (household surveys, vulnerability assessments, rapid assessments). Standard practice for community-based data collection. Required for track

attributes.name: field_team_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.field_team. Business justification: Field teams conduct needs assessments; supervisors need team-level assessment quality assurance and workload tracking. enumerator_volunteer_id covers individual enumerators but not the deploying field

attributes.name: grant_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.grant_budget. Business justification: Needs assessments are funded by specific grants; donor financial reporting requires tracking assessment activity costs against the grant budget. NGO finance officers report assessment expenditure per

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household unit that is the subject of this assessment when assessment_level is 'household'. Nullable when assessment_level is 'individual' or 'community'.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Household-Level Assessment Standards; KoboToolbox Household Survey Module

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the humanitarian or development program under which this needs assessment was commissioned. Links the assessment to the program's Theory of Change (ToC) and LogFrame targeting criteria.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Program Management Module; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Needs assessments are conducted by field teams under specific org units. Linking enables organizational aggregation of assessment findings for program planning, budget allocation, and donor reporting

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.partner_org. Business justification: Partners conduct needs assessments in their operational areas under consortium or sub-award arrangements. Tracking the assessing partner is required for data quality oversight, capacity assessment val

attributes.name: primary_beneficiary_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member or volunteer who conducted the field assessment. Used for quality assurance, inter-rater reliability checks, and enumerator performance monitoring.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Accountability to Affected Populations; CommCare Field Worker Module

attributes.name: project_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.project_site. Business justification: Needs assessments are conducted at specific project sites. Field coordinators filter assessments by site for program targeting and HRP reporting. No existing project_site_id on this product; admin1_na

attributes.name: registrant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual beneficiary (IDP, PoC, GBV survivor, or other target population member) who is the subject of this assessment when assessment_level is 'individual'. Nullable when assessment_level is 'household' or 'community'.
attributes.references: CommCare Case Management — Beneficiary Case ID; UNHCR PoC Registration Standards

attributes.name: reporting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mel.reporting_period. Business justification: Baseline/midline/endline needs assessment alignment: NGO MEL frameworks require needs assessments to be explicitly tied to reporting periods (baseline, midline, endline) for longitudinal tracking of v

attributes.name: vulnerability_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to beneficiary.vulnerability_profile. Business justification: Needs assessments are often conducted in direct reference to an existing vulnerability profile, or they generate/update a vulnerability profile. Linking beneficiary_needs_assessment to vulnerability_p

attributes.name: admin1_name
attributes.description: Name of the first-level administrative division (e.g., province, state, region) where the assessment was conducted. Sourced from OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs) administrative boundary reference. Used for geographic aggregation in SitReps and donor reports.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs) — Administrative Boundaries; IATI Country/Region Codes

attributes.name: admin2_name
attributes.description: Name of the second-level administrative division (e.g., district, county, department) where the assessment was conducted. Sourced from OCHA CODs. Enables sub-national geographic disaggregation for targeting and cluster coordination reporting.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs) — Administrative Boundaries

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the needs assessment was physically conducted in the field. This is the principal real-world event date, distinct from the record submission or validation timestamps. Used for temporal targeting analysis and periodic reassessment scheduling.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Needs Assessment Timing; OCHA Assessment Registry Standards

attributes.name: assessment_level
attributes.description: The unit of analysis at which this needs assessment was conducted. 'individual' targets a single beneficiary (e.g., GBV survivor, SAM case); 'household' targets a family unit; 'community' targets a settlement or geographic cluster. Determines which of beneficiary_id, household_id, or community_id is populated.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook Chapter 1 — Needs Assessment Methodology; IASC Needs Assessment Task Force Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this needs assessment, used in field reports, SitReps, and donor communications. Format: NA-{COUNTRY}-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Sourced from KoboToolbox or CommCare submission ID.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03 — Activity Identifier; KoboToolbox Form Submission Reference

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the needs assessment record. 'draft' indicates field data entry in progress; 'submitted' indicates enumerator submission pending review; 'validated' indicates supervisor-approved and usable for targeting; 'rejected' indicates data quality failure requiring re-assessment.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Data Quality Standards; KoboToolbox Submission Workflow

attributes.name: assessment_tool_version
attributes.description: Version number or deployment date of the assessment tool/form used. Critical for longitudinal comparability — when a KoboToolbox form or CommCare module is updated, findings from different versions may not be directly comparable without version-aware analysis.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Form Versioning; IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Comparability Standards

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment's purpose and methodology. 'initial_registration' is conducted at first beneficiary contact; 'periodic_reassessment' is a scheduled follow-up to update vulnerability status; 'post_crisis_rapid' is an emergency rapid assessment following a shock event; 'sector_specific_deep' is an in-depth assessment for a single sector (e.g., nutrition MUAC screening, WASH facility survey).
attributes.references: IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Assessment Types Taxonomy; OCHA Assessment Registry

attributes.name: children_under5_count
attributes.description: Number of children under 5 years of age in the assessed household. Key vulnerability indicator for nutrition (SAM/GAM screening), WASH (diarrhoea risk), and child protection programming. Required for UNICEF and WFP programme targeting.
attributes.references: UNICEF Child Vulnerability Standards; SPHERE Handbook — Nutrition (Under-5 Focus); WFP Targeting Criteria

attributes.name: consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether informed consent was obtained from the beneficiary or household head prior to conducting the assessment. Mandatory per CHS Commitment 4 (Accountability to Affected Populations) and GDPR Article 6 for data processing lawfulness. Must be TRUE for the record to be validated.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Commitment 4 Accountability; GDPR Article 6 Lawful Basis; HAP Standard

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The form of informed consent obtained. 'verbal' is spoken consent recorded by enumerator; 'written' is signed consent form; 'proxy' is consent given by a guardian or community leader on behalf of a vulnerable individual (e.g., child, person with disability). Relevant for legal compliance and data protection audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 — Conditions for Consent; CHS Alliance Data Protection Guidelines; ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the assessment was conducted (e.g., 'SOM', 'SSD', 'HTI'). Used for IATI reporting, donor country-level aggregation, and cross-country comparative analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI Standard v2.03 — Country Code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this needs assessment record was first created in the data platform (Silver layer ingestion timestamp). Distinct from assessment_date (field event date). Used for data pipeline monitoring and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 — Record Keeping; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: The primary method used to gather assessment data. 'face_to_face' is direct in-person interview; 'remote_phone' is telephone-based; 'fgd' is a Focus Group Discussion (FGD); 'kii' is a Key Informant Interview (KII); 'observation' is direct field observation without interview; 'secondary_data' is derived from existing records. Affects data quality weighting in vulnerability scoring.
attributes.references: IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Data Collection Methodology; SPHERE Handbook

attributes.name: displacement_status
attributes.description: The displacement classification of the assessed individual or household at the time of assessment. 'idp' = Internally Displaced Person (IDP); 'refugee' = person with international protection status; 'returnee' = person returning to place of origin; 'host_community' = non-displaced community member hosting displaced persons. Critical for UNHCR/OCHA population movement tracking.
attributes.references: UNHCR Refugee Definition (1951 Convention); OCHA IDP Tracking Matrix (DTM); Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement

attributes.name: education_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the education sector assessment findings. Null if education was not included in sectors_assessed. Covers school access, enrollment barriers, learning environment safety, and teacher availability against SPHERE/INEE minimum standards.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Education; INEE Minimum Standards for Education in Emergencies; IASC Education Cluster

attributes.name: enumerator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text qualitative observations recorded by the field enumerator during the assessment. Captures contextual information not covered by structured questions (e.g., security constraints, access limitations, observed conditions). Used by supervisors during validation review.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox — Note Question Type; CommCare — Case Note Field; CHS Alliance Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: female_headed_household
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessed household is headed by a female. Female-headed households are a standard vulnerability marker in humanitarian targeting criteria and are required for gender disaggregation in donor reports (USAID, DFID/FCDO, UN Women standards).
attributes.references: USAID Gender Equality and Female Empowerment Policy; UN Women Humanitarian Action; IASC Gender Marker

attributes.name: gbv_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment identified elevated Gender-Based Violence (GBV) risk for the assessed individual or household. When TRUE, triggers referral to GBV case management pathway and PSS services. Classified as restricted PHI due to extreme sensitivity of GBV disclosure data.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Guidelines; UNHCR GBVIMS Data Protection Protocol; SPHERE Handbook — Protection Principles

attributes.name: gps_accuracy_meters
attributes.description: Estimated GPS accuracy in meters at the time of coordinate capture, as reported by the mobile device. KoboToolbox and CommCare record this automatically. Values above 30 meters may indicate unreliable location data and trigger data quality flags.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox GPS Question Type — Accuracy Field; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the assessment location captured by the field enumerator's device via KoboToolbox or CommCare GPS capture. Used for GIS mapping, cluster analysis, and geographic targeting in humanitarian response planning.
attributes.references: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap — WGS84 Coordinate Standard; OCHA GIS Standards

attributes.name: livelihoods_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the livelihoods sector assessment findings. Null if livelihoods was not included in sectors_assessed. Covers income sources, asset ownership, market access, and economic vulnerability indicators.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Livelihoods; IASC Livelihoods Cluster Assessment Framework; USAID BHA Livelihoods Assessment Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the assessment location captured by the field enumerator's device. Used alongside latitude for GIS mapping, spatial clustering, and geographic targeting in humanitarian response planning.
attributes.references: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap — WGS84 Coordinate Standard; OCHA GIS Standards

attributes.name: muac_mm
attributes.description: Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) measurement in millimetres for children under 5 or pregnant/lactating women, used to screen for acute malnutrition. MUAC < 115mm indicates SAM; 115–125mm indicates MAM. Classified as PHI as it is a direct health measurement linked to an individual. Null if not applicable to assessment subject.
attributes.references: WHO MUAC Screening Protocol; SPHERE Handbook — Nutrition; UNICEF MUAC Standards

attributes.name: nutrition_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the nutrition sector assessment findings. Null if nutrition was not included in sectors_assessed. Incorporates Global Acute Malnutrition (GAM) and Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) indicators where applicable. Feeds into DHIS2 nutrition indicator tracking.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Nutrition Chapter; WHO/UNICEF GAM/SAM Thresholds; DHIS2 Nutrition Indicators

attributes.name: overall_vulnerability_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score representing the assessed subject's overall vulnerability level, calculated from sector-specific findings using the program's scoring methodology (e.g., 0–100 scale). Feeds into vulnerability_profile updates when the score materially changes vulnerability classification. This is a raw assessment output, not a derived KPI.
attributes.references: IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Vulnerability Scoring; UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework

attributes.name: persons_with_disability_count
attributes.description: Number of household members with a physical, sensory, intellectual, or psychosocial disability. Required for disability-inclusive programming per IASC Guidelines on Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities in Humanitarian Action and CRPD compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IASC Guidelines on Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities; UN CRPD; Washington Group Short Set on Disability

attributes.name: protection_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the protection sector assessment findings. Null if protection was not included in sectors_assessed. Covers GBV risk, child protection, housing land and property rights, and documentation status. Sensitive findings are handled per GBV information management protocols.
attributes.references: IASC Protection Cluster — Assessment Standards; UNHCR GBV Information Management System (GBVIMS); SPHERE Handbook — Protection Principles

attributes.name: referral_recommended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment findings recommend referral of the beneficiary or household to one or more service providers or program interventions. When TRUE, a referral pathway is initiated in CommCare case management. Drives downstream case management workflow.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Commitment 3 (Referral Pathways); CommCare Case Management Referral Module

attributes.name: referral_sectors
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of sectors to which the beneficiary or household is being referred based on assessment findings (e.g., 'nutrition|PSS|WASH'). Populated only when referral_recommended is TRUE. Drives service pathway activation in CommCare and Microsoft Dynamics 365 case management.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Commitment 3 (Referral Pathways); IASC Cluster Referral Protocols; CommCare Referral Module

attributes.name: sectors_assessed
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of humanitarian/development sectors covered in this assessment (e.g., 'WASH|nutrition|shelter|protection|livelihoods|education'). Sectors align with IASC cluster system. Determines which sector-specific scored findings fields are populated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WASH|nutrition|shelter|protection|livelihoods|education|health|food_security|NFI|PSS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IASC Cluster System — Sector Taxonomy; SPHERE Handbook — Sector Chapters; OCHA Cluster Coordination

attributes.name: shelter_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the shelter sector assessment findings. Null if shelter was not included in sectors_assessed. Assessed against SPHERE minimum standards for covered living space, structural safety, and thermal comfort.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Shelter and Settlement Chapter; IASC Shelter Cluster Assessment Standards

attributes.name: source_submission_reference
attributes.description: The native submission or case ID from the originating source system (KoboToolbox submission UUID or CommCare case ID). Enables exact record traceability back to the source system for data reconciliation, duplicate detection, and audit purposes.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox API — Submission UUID; CommCare API — Case ID; Databricks Silver Layer Lineage

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this assessment record originated. Enables data lineage tracking and source-specific quality rules in the Silver layer. 'KoboToolbox' for field survey submissions; 'CommCare' for mobile case management assessments; 'manual_entry' for paper-based data entry.
attributes.references: IATI Standard — Data Provenance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer — Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: supervisor_validation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the supervising data manager or MEL officer during the assessment review and validation process. Documents reasons for rejection, data quality concerns, or approval rationale. Populated when assessment_status transitions to 'validated' or 'rejected'.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Data Quality and Accountability Standards; MEAL Framework — Data Verification Protocols

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this needs assessment record was most recently modified in the data platform. Tracks post-ingestion corrections, validation status changes, and supervisor note additions. Required for Silver layer change data capture (CDC) processing.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer — CDC Standards; CHS Alliance Data Management Principles

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the assessment record was validated or rejected by the supervising staff member. Distinct from assessment_date (field event) and created_timestamp (record creation). Used for SLA monitoring of data quality review turnaround.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Data Quality Standards; MEAL Framework

attributes.name: vulnerability_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the assessed subject's vulnerability level derived from the overall_vulnerability_score and program-specific thresholds. Used for beneficiary targeting, prioritization, and service referral decisions. 'critical' triggers immediate case management escalation.
attributes.references: UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework; IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Vulnerability Classification

attributes.name: wash_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) Sector Score

attributes.name: biometric_enrollment_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary has consented to biometric data enrollment (fingerprint, iris scan, facial recognition) for identity verification and deduplication purposes. True = biometric enrollment permitted; False = not permitted.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9 (Special Categories of Personal Data); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; UNHCR Biometric Data Policy

attributes.name: chs_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record meets all requirements of the Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4 on accountability to affected populations. True = CHS compliant; False = non-compliant or pending review. Used in CHS certification audits.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — CHS Commitment 4; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: collection_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country where consent was collected (e.g., 'SOM' for Somalia, 'SSD' for South Sudan). Supports multi-country program reporting and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; IATI Standard; OCHA (Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs) Reporting Standards

attributes.name: collection_location
attributes.description: Name or description of the physical location where consent was collected (e.g., registration site name, health facility, IDP camp name, community center). Supports geographic analysis and field operations reporting.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards; OCHA (Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs) Reporting Standards

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the beneficiary provided, withdrew, or refused consent. This is the principal real-world event date for the consent transaction, distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: consent_form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent form template used at the time of consent collection (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Enables tracking of which version of the consent language and terms the beneficiary agreed to, critical for compliance audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: consent_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-3 language code representing the language in which consent was communicated and obtained. Ensures accountability that consent was given in the beneficiary's understood language (e.g., 'ar' for Arabic, 'fr' for French, 'so' for Somali). Critical for CHS accountability compliance.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; ISO 639-1 Language Codes; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The method by which consent was obtained from the beneficiary. 'verbal' for spoken agreement (audio-recorded or witnessed); 'written' for signed paper form; 'digital' for electronic signature or mobile app confirmation; 'thumbprint' for biometric ink impression; 'proxy' for consent given by a guardian or authorized representative on behalf of a minor or incapacitated individual.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; GDPR Article 7; KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards

attributes.name: consent_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric reference code assigned to this consent record, used in field operations, case referrals, and compliance reporting. Format: CNS-[COUNTRY]-[YEAR]-[SEQUENCE].
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards; IATI Transparency Standard

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent record. 'given' indicates active informed consent; 'withdrawn' indicates the beneficiary has revoked consent; 'pending' indicates consent is awaited; 'expired' indicates the consent period has lapsed; 'refused' indicates explicit refusal.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specific type of consent being recorded. Covers data processing consent (GDPR/privacy), photography and media use, inter-agency case referral, biometric enrollment, program participation, and research/survey participation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: data_processing|photography_media|case_referral|biometric_enrollment|program_participation|research_survey — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; GDPR Article 6; IATI Standard; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting data lineage, compliance reporting, and GDPR accountability obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) (Accountability Principle); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: data_retention_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days for which the beneficiary's data may be retained under this consent, as agreed at the time of consent collection. Drives automated data retention and deletion workflows. Aligned with GDPR storage limitation principle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) (Storage Limitation); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: data_scope
attributes.description: Description of the specific data elements, activities, or purposes covered by this consent record (e.g., 'collection and storage of household survey data', 'sharing of case data with UNHCR for referral'). Defines the boundaries of what the beneficiary has consented to.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(b) (Purpose Limitation); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; IATI Standard

attributes.name: digital_signature_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or hash of the digital signature captured when consent_method is 'digital'. Links to the secure digital signature storage system. Not the signature itself — a reference token for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; eIDAS Regulation (EU Electronic Signatures); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the consent becomes legally and operationally binding. May differ from consent_date if there is a processing delay or a future-dated consent arrangement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent expires and must be renewed. Nullable for open-ended consents. Supports automated consent renewal workflows and compliance with data retention policies.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) (Storage Limitation); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; IATI Standard

attributes.name: form_attachment_reference
attributes.description: File path, URL, or document management system reference to the scanned or digital copy of the signed consent form. Enables retrieval of the original consent document for audit and legal purposes.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applies to this consent record based on the beneficiary's location, the organization's jurisdiction, or the data controller's domicile. True = GDPR applies; False = GDPR does not apply.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 (Territorial Scope); GDPR Article 6 (Lawfulness of Processing)

attributes.name: informed_consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether a supervisor or quality assurance officer has verified that the consent was truly informed (i.e., the beneficiary understood the purpose, scope, and their rights before consenting). True = verified; False = pending verification.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: is_proxy_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether consent was given by a proxy (guardian, parent, or authorized representative) on behalf of a minor, elderly, or incapacitated beneficiary. True = proxy consent; False = direct consent from the beneficiary.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; GDPR Article 8 (Conditions for Child Consent)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional contextual notes about the consent process, any special circumstances, beneficiary concerns raised, or follow-up actions required. Used by field staff and MEL officers for qualitative documentation.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: photography_permitted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Photography and Media Use Permitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary has consented to being photographed or filmed for organizational communications, donor reporting, or advocacy purposes. True = photography/media use permitted; False = not permitted.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: proxy_name
attributes.description: Full name of the proxy individual (guardian, parent, or authorized representative) who provided consent on behalf of the beneficiary. Populated only when is_proxy_consent is True.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: proxy_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the proxy consent giver to the beneficiary (e.g., parent, guardian, legal representative). Populated only when is_proxy_consent is True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent|guardian|spouse|sibling|community_leader|legal_representative|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; GDPR Article 8

attributes.name: sharing_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary has consented to their data being shared with third-party organizations (e.g., partner NGOs, UN agencies, government bodies). True = sharing permitted; False = sharing not permitted. Critical for inter-agency data sharing compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: sharing_restrictions
attributes.description: Free-text description of any specific restrictions or conditions placed by the beneficiary on data sharing (e.g., 'not to be shared with government authorities', 'only for health program purposes'). Populated when sharing_permitted is True but with conditions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this consent record in the originating operational system (CommCare case ID, KoboToolbox submission UUID, Dynamics 365 record ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and source systems.
attributes.references: IATI Standard; Internal Data Lineage and Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this consent record was captured or ingested (e.g., CommCare for mobile case management, KoboToolbox for field surveys, Dynamics 365 for case management, Salesforce for constituent tracking, or manual for paper-based entry).
attributes.references: IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was most recently modified. Tracks consent status changes, withdrawals, and verification updates for audit trail and data governance purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) (Accountability Principle); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which a supervisor or quality assurance officer verified that the consent was properly informed and documented. Populated only when informed_consent_verified is True.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the beneficiary formally withdrew their previously given consent. Populated only when consent_status is 'withdrawn'. Triggers downstream data deletion or anonymization workflows per GDPR right to erasure.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3) (Right to Withdraw Consent); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the beneficiary or their representative for withdrawing consent. Populated only when consent_status is 'withdrawn'. Used for accountability reporting and program improvement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard

attributes.name: witness_name
attributes.description: Full name of the field staff member or community witness who witnessed the consent process. Required for verbal and thumbprint consent methods to ensure accountability and legal validity.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; HAP (Humanitarian Accountability Partnership) Standard; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.description: Sequential version number of the risk register entry. Incremented each time the risk assessment is updated, supporting risk evolution tracking across the program lifecycle.

products.name: implementation_plan
products.description: Detailed implementation plan (work plan) for a program intervention or component, serving as the operational roadmap for field teams and the baseline for progress tracking. Stores plan version, planning period, approval status, and last revision date. This is the SSOT for all program scheduling, activity sequencing, and milestone management — the schedule authority for donor reporting timelines and grant compliance.

products.name: review_event
products.description: Unified record for all formal program review, reporting, and learning events including mid-term reviews, annual reviews, after-action reviews, donor review missions, progress reports (quarterly, semi-annual, annual, final, SitRep, flash report), and structured learning outputs (lessons learned, best practices, innovations, failure analyses). Captures event/report type, reporting period, date range, review team/author, scope, key findings, narrative sections (progress against outputs, challenges, beneficiary reach figures, financial summary), recommendations, management response, follow-up actions, submission date, submission status, approval workflow, and dissemination status. Serves as the SSOT for all program knowledge events, donor/cluster reporting submissions, and internal governance reporting. Distinct from MEL domain evaluations (which own evaluation methodology, TOR, and evaluator management) — this product owns the program management reporting and review lifecycle.

domains.name: grant
domains.description: Authoritative domain for all grant awards, funding agreements, and donor contracts. Manages grant lifecycle from proposal development and submission through award, amendment, budget tracking, compliance, and closeout. Tracks donor conditions, restricted vs. unrestricted funding, NICRA/ICR rates, and compliance obligations under USAID, BHA, DFID, CERF, and OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.

products.name: award
products.description: Master record for each grant award received by the NGO from institutional donors (USAID, BHA, DFID, CERF, UN agencies, foundations, corporates). Captures the full grant lifecycle from award notification through closeout. Stores award number, title, donor reference, award type (cooperative agreement, contract, grant, sub-award, consortium lead, consortium member), total obligated amount in award currency with exchange rate to functional currency, authorized amount, start and end dates, period of performance, award status (pipeline, active, no-cost extension, closed), funding mechanism, geographic scope, thematic sector, applicable regulatory framework (2 CFR 200, USAID ADS, DFID Smart Rules), NICRA/ICR rate reference, restricted vs. unrestricted classification, indirect cost ceiling, and program linkage allocations with funding percentages. SSOT for all grant award identity in the NGO.

Each proposal references the solicitation it responds to (except unsolicited proposals).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this donor condition record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently the organization monitors progress toward meeting this condition. Values: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, as_needed.

attributes.name: next_recurrence_date
attributes.description: For recurring conditions, the date of the next scheduled occurrence or deadline. Null for one-time conditions.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next review of this donor condition.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this condition based on risk, donor emphasis, or organizational impact. Values: critical (non-compliance could result in grant suspension or termination), high (significant risk or donor focus), medium (standard condition), low (minor or administrative condition).

attributes.name: recurrence_frequency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition is a one-time requirement or recurs on a regular schedule. Values: one_time (single occurrence), monthly, quarterly, semi_annually, annually, as_needed (triggered by specific events).

attributes.name: regulatory_citation

attributes.name: risk_rating

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to supporting documentation related to this condition (e.g., approval letters, waiver memos, compliance evidence, submitted reports).

attributes.name: waiver_date
attributes.description: The date on which the donor formally waived this condition. Null if the condition was not waived.

attributes.name: waiver_justification

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: donor_report

Defines the complete reporting schedule including report type (SF-425 Federal Financial Report, quarterly programmatic, annual narrative, SitRep, final report, IATI disclosure), reporting frequency (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, ad hoc), due dates, and responsible staff. Tracks each report submission through its lifecycle: upcoming → draft → submitted → accepted/revision requested → final. Captures submission method (email, donor portal, USAID ASIST, DFID ARIES), financial figures reported, narrative summary reference, version number, and reporting period covered. Supports compliance tracking, donor relationship management, and audit accountability under CHS and HAP standards.

products.name: funding_source
products.description: Reference master for all funding sources and donor funding mechanisms used across grant awards. Captures funding source name, donor organization reference, funding mechanism type (ODA bilateral, multilateral, foundation grant, corporate philanthropy, CERF pooled fund, government contract), ODA/DAC classification, SDG alignment codes, geographic restrictions, thematic restrictions, currency, and IATI organization identifier. Enables portfolio analysis by funding source and donor compliance segmentation. Lives in the grant domain as the grant-facing classification of how funding flows to awards — distinct from the donor domains relationship and stewardship records which track the institutional relationship, communication history, and cultivation pipeline with the funding organization itself.

attributes.name: funding_source_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the funding source record. Primary key.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to donor.constituent. Business justification: A funding source IS a donor constituent entity. NGO donor relationship management and IATI reporting require linking funding sources to constituent records for portfolio analysis, giving history, and

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the donor organization that provides this funding source. Links to the institutional donor entity in the donor domain.

attributes.name: advance_payment_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this funding source permits advance payments or cash advances to be disbursed before costs are incurred. Affects cash flow management and liquidity planning.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.305, Donor Payment Terms

attributes.name: allowable_cost_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cost categories or Chart of Accounts codes that are allowable under this funding source (e.g., personnel, travel, equipment, supplies). Used to enforce budget compliance and prevent unallowable cost charges.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart E, Donor Budget Guidelines

attributes.name: audit_requirement
attributes.description: The type of audit required by the donor for grants funded by this source. Single audit refers to OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart F audits; program-specific audit refers to audits of individual programs; financial audit refers to organization-wide financial statement audits; no audit required indicates the donor does not mandate an audit.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart F, Donor Agreement Terms

attributes.name: budget_flexibility
attributes.description: Classification of the degree of budget flexibility allowed by the donor for grants funded by this source. Fixed budgets require donor approval for any changes; flexible within categories allows reallocation within cost categories; flexible with approval allows reallocation with prior donor consent; fully flexible allows unrestricted reallocation.
attributes.references: Donor Agreement Terms, Budget Management Guidelines

attributes.name: budget_revision_threshold
attributes.description: The percentage threshold (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.1000 for 10%) above which budget revisions or reallocations require prior donor approval. Null if no threshold applies.

attributes.name: closeout_period_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days after the grant end date within which all closeout activities (final reports, financial reconciliation, asset disposition) must be completed for grants funded by this source.

attributes.name: compliance_framework

attributes.name: cost_share_required

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate_type
attributes.description: The type of indirect cost rate mechanism applicable to this funding source. NICRA refers to a formally negotiated rate; de minimis refers to the 10% rate allowed under 2 CFR 200.414(f); cost reimbursement, fixed rate, and negotiated rate represent other donor-specific mechanisms.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this funding source record was last updated in the grant management system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: nicra_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement (NICRA) Rate
attributes.description: The negotiated indirect cost rate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.1500 for 15%) applicable to this funding source for recovering facilities and administration costs. Used for US federal grants under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, NICRA Agreement

attributes.name: oda_dac_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Official Development Assistance (ODA) Development Assistance Committee (DAC) Classification
attributes.description: The OECD Development Assistance Committee classification code for this funding source if it qualifies as Official Development Assistance. Used for international aid transparency and reporting to DAC member countries.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The standard payment method used by the donor organization to disburse funds from this funding source (e.g., wire transfer, ACH, check, letter of credit, direct deposit, pooled fund transfer).
attributes.references: Donor Payment Terms, Treasury Management Standard

attributes.name: procurement_standards
attributes.description: Description of the procurement and contracting standards that must be followed when using this funding source (e.g., OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.318-200.326, USAID Mandatory Standard Provisions, DFID Procurement Guidelines). Ensures compliance with donor procurement rules.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.318-200.326, Donor Procurement Guidelines

attributes.name: program_income_treatment
attributes.description: The method by which program income earned under grants funded by this source must be treated per OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.307. Addition means income is added to the grant; deduction means income reduces the donor share; cost-sharing means income is used to meet cost-share requirements; no program income indicates the funding source does not generate program income.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.307, Donor Agreement Terms

attributes.name: record_retention_years
attributes.description: The number of years that financial and programmatic records for grants funded by this source must be retained after grant closeout, as required by the donor or applicable regulations (e.g., OMB Uniform Guidance requires 3 years).
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.334, Donor Agreement Terms

attributes.name: sdg_alignment_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of United Nations Sustainable Development Goal codes (e.g., SDG 1, SDG 3, SDG 5) that this funding source is aligned with or restricted to support. Enables portfolio analysis by SDG impact area.

attributes.name: subaward_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this funding source permits the organization to issue subawards or subgrants to implementing partners and community-based organizations.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.331, Donor Agreement Terms

attributes.name: subaward_approval_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the donor organization must provide prior written approval before the organization can issue subawards using this funding source.

attributes.name: thematic_restriction
attributes.description: Description of thematic or sectoral restrictions on the use of this funding source (e.g., WASH programs only, education initiatives, health services, emergency response). Empty if no thematic restrictions apply.
attributes.references: Donor Agreement Terms, OECD DAC Sector Codes

attributes.name: total_funding_available
attributes.description: The total amount of funding available from this source across all grant awards, expressed in the funding source currency. May represent a ceiling or allocation limit.

attributes.name: unallowable_cost_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cost categories or Chart of Accounts codes that are explicitly unallowable under this funding source (e.g., alcohol, entertainment, lobbying). Used to enforce budget compliance and prevent unallowable cost charges.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart E, Donor Budget Guidelines

products.name: cost_share_commitment
products.description: Tracks cost-share and matching fund commitments required by donors as a condition of the grant award. Captures cost-share type (cash, in-kind, third-party), required cost-share amount or percentage, committed amount, verified amount, cost-share source description, verification method, reporting period, and compliance status. Ensures the NGO meets its cost-share obligations under 2 CFR 200.306 and donor-specific matching requirements, and supports documentation for audits.

attributes.name: cost_share_commitment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost-share commitment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.partnership_agreement. Business justification: Cost share commitments from implementing partners are formalized within partnership agreements. This FK links each cost share commitment to its governing agreement, enabling financial auditors to veri

attributes.name: approved_by_staff_member_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved By Staff Member Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.staff_member. Business justification: Cost share commitments require an authorized internal approver for donor compliance and single-audit purposes. 'approved_by_name' is a denormalized staff name. Linking to staff_member enables approval

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grant award that requires this cost-share commitment.

attributes.name: budget_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget_line. Business justification: Cost share commitments map to specific budget lines to demonstrate proper categorization and allowability per donor requirements. Auditors verify this mapping during single audits (2 CFR 200.306). Fin

attributes.name: budget_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.budget_plan. Business justification: NGO cost-share compliance: cost-share commitments must be matched against specific budget plan versions for audit verification. Donors and auditors require evidence that cost-share contributions align

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.commodity. Business justification: In-kind cost share commitments in NGOs frequently involve specific commodities (donated food, NFIs, medicines). Linking to commodity enables 'in-kind cost share valuation and donor reporting' — the co

attributes.name: donor_constituent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to donor.constituent. Business justification: Cost share commitments often provided by external donors/foundations as matching funds. Tracks which donor constituent provided the cost share for grant compliance, donor recognition, and stewardship

attributes.name: donor_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.donor_requirement. Business justification: Cost share commitments are frequently mandated by specific donor requirements in the award agreement. Linking cost_share_commitment to the originating donor_requirement allows compliance teams to veri

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_fund. Business justification: Cost share contributions are sourced from specific restricted or unrestricted funds. Finance tracks which fund provides the cost share to ensure fund-level compliance, proper restriction treatment, an

attributes.name: grant_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.grant_amendment. Business justification: Cost share commitments can be created or revised through grant amendments (e.g., an amendment that changes the cost share percentage or required amount). Linking cost_share_commitment to the authorizi

attributes.name: grant_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.grant_budget. Business justification: Cost share commitments are tracked against a specific grant budget that holds the required cost share amount and percentage. Compliance officers verify committed vs. required cost share against the gr

attributes.name: indicator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mel.indicator. Business justification: Cost share contributions are often tied to specific program indicators to demonstrate that in-kind or cash contributions advance measurable results. Donors require cost-share verification reports show

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the program or project that benefits from this cost-share commitment.

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the implementing partner organization providing the cost-share contribution, if applicable.

attributes.name: project_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.project_site. Business justification: Cost share commitments (in-kind labor, materials, volunteer hours) are made at specific project sites. Site-level cost share tracking is required for donor audit verification, in-kind valuation, and c

attributes.name: reporting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mel.reporting_period. Business justification: Cost share commitments must be verified and reported within official MEL reporting periods. Linking to reporting_period replaces denormalized start/end date columns and aligns cost-share verification

attributes.name: volunteer_deployment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to volunteer.volunteer_deployment. Business justification: Cost-share commitments sourced from volunteer labor must reference the specific deployment generating the in-kind contribution. cost_share_commitment already has volunteer_hourly_rate and volunteer_ho

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cost-share commitment or verification was formally approved.

attributes.name: approved_by_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the individual who approved the cost-share commitment or verification.

attributes.name: audit_finding_reference
attributes.description: Reference to any audit findings or observations related to this cost-share commitment, if applicable.

attributes.name: commitment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cost-share commitment was formally made by the NGO or partner organization.

attributes.name: commitment_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding this cost-share commitment, including any special conditions or donor instructions.

attributes.name: commitment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or code assigned to this cost-share commitment for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: commitment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost-share commitment: planned (identified but not yet committed), committed (formally committed), verified (documentation complete and approved), partially_verified (some verification complete), non_compliant (commitment not met), or waived (donor waived requirement).

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Amount formally committed by the NGO or partner to meet the cost-share requirement, expressed in the grant currency.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Compliance status of the cost-share commitment relative to donor requirements: compliant (requirement met), at_risk (commitment made but verification pending), non_compliant (requirement not met), waived (donor waived requirement), or pending_verification (awaiting documentation review).

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: Budget cost category or line item to which this cost-share commitment applies (e.g., personnel, equipment, travel, supplies).

attributes.name: cost_share_source_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the source of the cost-share contribution, including the contributing organization, department, or funding stream.

attributes.name: cost_share_type
attributes.description: Type of cost-share contribution: cash (direct monetary contribution), in-kind (goods or services), third-party (contributions from external partners), or volunteer (volunteer time and services).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost-share commitment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this commitment record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: donor_approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for donor approval or acknowledgment of the cost-share commitment and verification.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which this cost-share commitment is recognized.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this cost-share commitment is recognized for accounting and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the cost-share contribution is posted for financial tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: in_kind_valuation_method
attributes.description: Method used to value in-kind contributions (e.g., fair market value, independent appraisal, standard volunteer rate, depreciated asset value). Applicable only when cost_share_type is in-kind.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost-share commitment is mandatory per the grant agreement (true) or voluntary (false).

attributes.name: is_restricted_fund
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost-share contribution comes from restricted funds (true) or unrestricted funds (false).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost-share commitment record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: required_cost_share_amount
attributes.description: Total cost-share amount required by the donor as a condition of the grant award, expressed in the grant currency.

attributes.name: required_cost_share_percentage
attributes.description: Required cost-share expressed as a percentage of total project costs (e.g., 25.00 for 25% match requirement).

attributes.name: source_organization_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization providing the cost-share contribution (may be the NGO itself, a partner, or a third-party donor).

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to supporting documentation for this cost-share commitment (e.g., invoices, time sheets, valuation reports, donor letters).

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between the required cost-share amount and the verified amount (positive indicates shortfall, negative indicates excess).

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Variance expressed as a percentage of the required cost-share amount.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cost-share contribution was verified and approved.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the cost-share contribution: financial_audit (independent audit), invoice_review (invoice and receipt documentation), time_sheet (volunteer or staff time records), valuation_report (independent valuation for in-kind), donor_certification (donor letter), or third_party_letter (third-party confirmation).

attributes.name: verified_amount
attributes.description: Amount of cost-share that has been verified through documentation and approved by the donor or auditor, expressed in the grant currency.

attributes.name: volunteer_hourly_rate
attributes.description: Standard hourly rate used to value volunteer time for cost-share purposes. Applicable only when cost_share_type is volunteer.

attributes.name: volunteer_hours
attributes.description: Total number of volunteer hours contributed as part of this cost-share commitment. Applicable only when cost_share_type is volunteer.

domains.name: donor
domains.description: SSOT for all donor and funder relationships including institutional donors (USAID, DFID, UN agencies, DAC members), foundations, corporate sponsors, and individual major gift contributors. Manages donor cultivation, prospect research, stewardship, gift processing, pledge management, and CRM constituent engagement in Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud and Raisers Edge NXT.

products.name: constituent
products.description: Master identity record and single source of truth for all donor and funder constituents across Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud and Raisers Edge NXT. Represents every entity that gives to or funds the NGO — individual major gift contributors, institutional donors (USAID, DFID/FCDO, UN agencies, DAC members), bilateral and multilateral agencies, private foundations, corporate sponsors, and households. Captures full constituent profile including legal name, preferred name/salutation, constituent type (individual, institutional, foundation, corporate, bilateral, multilateral, household), organization affiliation, IATI organization identifier, communication preferences, GDPR/data consent flags, deceased indicator, ODA eligibility flag, indirect cost rate (ICR/NICRA) terms, preferred grant modality, relationship tier, funder classification (bilateral, multilateral, DAC), country of origin, and CRM source system reference. All gift, pledge, grant, soft credit, and cultivation records reference this entity as the authoritative donor identity.
products.reference: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Account/Contact; Raisers Edge NXT Constituent

attributes.name: constituent_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the constituent record. Primary key for the constituent entity representing every donor, funder, and supporter in the CRM (Constituent Relationship Management) system.
attributes.references: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Data Model; Raisers Edge NXT Schema

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: The constituent's preferred method of communication for stewardship, acknowledgment, and cultivation activities.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Engagement Model

attributes.name: constituent_type
attributes.description: The classification of the constituent entity. Individual = private person major gift donor; Institutional = government agency or public sector donor (USAID, DFID/FCDO); Foundation = private or family foundation; Corporate = business or corporate sponsor; Bilateral = government-to-government donor (DAC member); Multilateral = international organization (UN agencies, World Bank); Household = family unit for joint giving. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|institutional|foundation|corporate|bilateral|multilateral|household — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATI Organization Type Codelist; DAC (Development Assistance Committee) Donor Classification; Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Account Types

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the constituent's country of origin or headquarters. For bilateral and multilateral donors, this is the donor country. For foundations and corporates, this is the country of incorporation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; DAC (Development Assistance Committee) Donor Country Classification

attributes.name: crm_source_record_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Constituent Relationship Management (CRM) Source Record Identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this constituent record in the source CRM system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and bi-directional sync.
attributes.references: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Integration Standards; Raisers Edge NXT API Documentation

attributes.name: crm_source_system
attributes.description: The source CRM system from which this constituent record originated. Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud = Salesforce NPSP or Nonprofit Cloud; Raisers Edge NXT = Blackbaud Raisers Edge NXT; Other = other donor management system.
attributes.references: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Data Model; Raisers Edge NXT Schema; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: dac_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this constituent is a member of the OECD Development Assistance Committee. True = DAC member; False = not a DAC member. Used for ODA reporting and donor classification.
attributes.references: OECD DAC Member List; IATI Reporting Standards

attributes.name: deceased_date
attributes.description: The date on which the constituent passed away. Used for planned giving, estate gift tracking, and memorial acknowledgment.
attributes.references: Raisers Edge NXT Planned Giving Module

attributes.name: deceased_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the constituent is deceased. True = deceased; False = living. Used to prevent inappropriate communications and for planned giving tracking.
attributes.references: Raisers Edge NXT Constituent Management; Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: email_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the constituent has explicitly consented to receive email communications. True = opted in; False = opted out or consent not given.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CAN-SPAM Act; Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations

attributes.name: estimated_giving_capacity
attributes.description: The estimated total giving capacity of the constituent based on wealth screening, prospect research, and capacity analysis. Expressed in USD. Used for major gift solicitation strategy and campaign goal setting.
attributes.references: Raisers Edge NXT Prospect Research Module; Wealth Screening Best Practices

attributes.name: first_gift_date
attributes.description: The date of the first gift or grant received from this constituent. Used for donor tenure analysis, anniversary recognition, and retention metrics.
attributes.references: Raisers Edge NXT Gift History; Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Donor Lifecycle Tracking

attributes.name: funder_classification
attributes.description: The classification of the funder based on international development and humanitarian standards. Bilateral = government-to-government donor; Multilateral = international organization (UN, World Bank); DAC Member = OECD Development Assistance Committee member country; Foundation = private or family foundation; Corporate = business or corporate sponsor; Individual = private individual donor; Other = other funder type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bilateral|multilateral|dac_member|foundation|corporate|individual|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OECD DAC Donor Classification; IATI Organization Type Codelist; OCHA (Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs) Donor Taxonomy

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Date
attributes.description: The date on which the constituent provided GDPR consent for data processing. Used for audit and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the constituent has provided explicit consent for data processing under GDPR requirements. True = consent given; False = consent not given or withdrawn.

attributes.name: iati_organization_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) Organization Identifier
attributes.description: The globally unique identifier for the organization as registered in the IATI registry. Used for transparency reporting and tracking ODA (Official Development Assistance) flows. Format: country-code-registration-agency-identifier (e.g., US-EIN-123456789, GB-COH-12345678).
attributes.references: IATI Organization Identifier Standard; International Aid Transparency Initiative Registry

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated indirect cost rate (also known as NICRA - Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement) that this donor allows for F&A (Facilities and Administration) costs. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 for 15%). Used for grant budgeting and financial planning.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.414; NICRA Standards; USAID Indirect Cost Rate Policies

attributes.name: largest_gift_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the largest single gift or grant received from this constituent. Expressed in USD. Used for major gift benchmarking and solicitation strategy.

attributes.name: last_gift_date

attributes.name: legal_name

products.name: gift
products.description: Authoritative transactional ledger and single source of truth for every financial transaction in the donor domain — gifts, donations, matching gifts, tribute gifts, refunds, adjustments, and acknowledgements — processed through Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud and Raisers Edge NXT. This is the ONE table that answers 'what is this donor's total giving?' Captures gift date, amount, currency, gift type discriminator (cash, check, wire, in-kind, stock, crypto, matching, tribute, refund/adjustment, recurring), fund designation, campaign and appeal attribution, gift source (online, direct mail, event, major gift officer), payment method, batch reference, anonymous flag, restricted vs. unrestricted designation, and GL posting reference. For matching gifts: match ratio, matching employer/corporation, match request date, match approval status, match payment received date, maximum match amount. For tribute gifts: tribute type (in-memoriam, in-honor-of), honoree name, honoree relationship, notification recipient, notification sent flag. For refunds/adjustments: original gift reference, refund date, refund amount, refund reason, refund method, GL reversal reference. For acknowledgements: acknowledgement type, acknowledgement date, receipt number, delivery method, acknowledgement status, IRS-compliant language flag, goods-or-services disclosure. Core financial transaction for donor revenue recognition per FASB ASC 958 and IRS 501(c)(3) substantiation requirements.
products.reference: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Gift; Raisers Edge NXT Gift; FASB ASC 958 Contribution Revenue

products.name: pledge
products.description: Tracks multi-installment giving commitments, pledge agreements, and their individual installment schedules from donors, managed in Raisers Edge NXT and Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud. Captures pledge date, total pledge amount, installment schedule (monthly, quarterly, annual), number of installments, pledge balance outstanding, pledge status (active, fulfilled, lapsed, written-off), fund designation, campaign, appeal, reminder schedule, and write-off reason. Includes installment-level detail: individual due dates, scheduled amounts, actual payment dates, amounts paid, installment status (scheduled, paid, overdue, skipped, waived), payment method, and linked gift reference upon payment. Enables granular pledge fulfillment tracking, overdue installment identification, automated reminder generation, and BvA (Budget vs. Actual) reconciliation for pledged revenue. Distinct from gift — a pledge is a commitment to give, not a completed transaction.

products.name: segment
products.description: Donor segmentation master records and constituent-to-segment membership assignments used for targeted fundraising, stewardship, and communication strategies. Captures segment definition (name, type, criteria, owner, creation date, status) and constituent membership records including assignment date, assigned-by staff member, assignment source (manual, automated RFM scoring, wealth screening import), expiry date, is_active flag, and segment transition history. Segment types include giving level (major, mid-level, annual), recency-frequency-monetary (RFM) tier, donor type, geographic, programmatic interest, acquisition channel, and lifecycle stage. Enables LYBUNT (Last Year But Unfortunately Not This Year), SYBUNT, and RFM-based segmentation for direct mail, email, and major gift cultivation strategies. Supports point-in-time segment membership queries and longitudinal donor behavior analysis.

products.name: assessment
products.description: Master record of a structured field assessment conducted to evaluate needs, context, or program outcomes. Covers all assessment types including FGD (Focus Group Discussion), KII (Key Informant Interview), household survey, rapid needs assessment, PDM (Post-Distribution Monitoring) with linked distribution event and utilization/adequacy scoring, market assessment, and MUAC screening. Captures assessment date, project site, methodology, target population, sample size, assessment team, KoboToolbox or CommCare form ID, data collection tool, key findings summary, recommendations, and assessment status (planned, in-progress, completed, validated). For PDM assessments: captures linked distribution event, sample methodology, utilization rate, adequacy score, beneficiary satisfaction, complaints received, and protection concerns noted. Links to assessment_response for individual submissions. Supports MEL indicator tracking, SitRep generation, CHS compliance, accountability to affected populations (AAP), and donor reporting on program quality.

products.name: logframe
products.description: Logical Framework (LogFrame) master records defining the results chain hierarchy for each program or grant. Each logframe captures the full intervention logic: goal (impact), purpose (outcome), outputs, activities, assumptions, risks, and objectively verifiable indicators (OVIs) at each level. Includes Theory of Change (ToC) components as embedded rows within the hierarchy. Aligns with DAC evaluation criteria, RBM standards, and donor-specific logframe templates (DFID/FCDO, USAID, EU, ECHO). Links to indicator targets for performance tracking and supports results framework reporting.

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Manages the humanitarian supply chain including procurement, warehousing, inventory of NFIs (Non-Food Items) and medical supplies, last-mile logistics, vendor management, commodity pipelines, in-kind donations, distribution planning, and emergency relief commodities to support field delivery operations.

products.name: commodity
products.description: Master catalog of all humanitarian commodities and relief items managed in the supply chain, including NFIs (Non-Food Items), medical supplies, WASH materials, food commodities, shelter materials, and emergency relief goods. Defines item specifications, unit of measure, commodity category (e.g., shelter, health, nutrition, WASH), SPHERE standards compliance, shelf life, storage requirements (temperature, humidity), hazardous classification, kit/assembly composition (bill of materials for NFI kits), cold-chain requirements, donor restrictions, and procurement lead time. This is the SSOT for all commodity definitions used across procurement, warehousing, and distribution.
