attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account. Primary key for the GL account master data.

attributes.name: account_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the GL account purpose, usage guidelines, and what types of transactions should be posted to this account.

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: The account group or category within the Chart of Accounts structure (e.g., 'Current Assets', 'Fixed Assets', 'Restricted Contributions', 'Program Expenses').

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The human-readable descriptive name of the GL account (e.g., 'Cash - Operating Account', 'Grant Revenue - USAID', 'Program Salaries - WASH').

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique account number within the Chart of Accounts (CoA) structure. This is the business identifier used in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP for all financial transactions and reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 - Not-for-Profit Entities, GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: account_owner
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the business owner or responsible party for this GL account (e.g., Finance Director, Program Manager, Grant Manager).

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the GL account: active (available for posting), inactive (temporarily suspended), blocked (posting prohibited), or closed (permanently retired).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting, Unit4 ERP

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the GL account: asset, liability, net asset (equity for nonprofits per FASB ASC 958), revenue, or expense.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 - Not-for-Profit Entities, GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: budget_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to budget control and Budget versus Actual (BvA) monitoring. When true, transactions require budget availability checking before posting.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Grant Management Best Practices

attributes.name: coa_structure_code
attributes.description: The Chart of Accounts structure identifier or version code. Nonprofits may maintain multiple CoA structures for different legal entities or reporting requirements.

attributes.name: consolidation_account_number
attributes.description: The GL account number used for consolidated financial reporting across multiple legal entities or country offices. Used when the nonprofit has a multi-entity structure.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_base_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account serves as an allocation base for distributing indirect costs across programs and grants (e.g., direct salaries, total direct costs).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for this GL account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Nonprofits operating internationally may maintain accounts in multiple currencies.

attributes.name: dac_sector_code
attributes.description: The OECD Development Assistance Committee sector classification code for international development activities. Required for International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) reporting.
attributes.references: OECD DAC, International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI)

attributes.name: donor_restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account tracks donor-restricted funds requiring specific usage compliance and separate reporting per donor agreements and FASB ASC 958.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this GL account was closed or became inactive. Null for currently active accounts.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this GL account became active and available for transaction posting in the Chart of Accounts.

attributes.name: external_reporting_code
attributes.description: The mapping code used for external regulatory reporting (e.g., IRS Form 990 line item, IATI activity code, donor-specific reporting category).
attributes.references: IRS Form 990, International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI)

attributes.name: financial_statement_classification
attributes.description: The primary financial statement where this account appears: balance sheet (statement of financial position), statement of activities (income statement equivalent for nonprofits), statement of functional expenses, statement of cash flows, or off-balance-sheet.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 - Not-for-Profit Entities, GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: functional_expense_category
attributes.description: The functional expense classification required by FASB ASC 958 for expense accounts: program services, management and general (administrative), fundraising, or not applicable (for non-expense accounts). Used for Form 990 reporting and functional expense allocation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 - Not-for-Profit Entities, IRS Form 990

attributes.name: fund_restriction_class
attributes.description: The net asset restriction classification per FASB ASC 958: unrestricted (no donor restrictions), temporarily restricted (time or purpose restrictions), or permanently restricted (endowment principal). Critical for nonprofit fund accounting and donor compliance.

attributes.name: grant_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether expenses posted to this account are eligible for reimbursement under federal grants per OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200. Critical for grant financial management and cost allocation.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The level of this account within the Chart of Accounts hierarchy (e.g., 1 for top-level summary accounts, 2 for sub-accounts, 3 for detail posting accounts).

attributes.name: indirect_cost_pool_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is part of the indirect cost pool for Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement (NICRA) calculations and Facilities and Administration (F&A) cost allocation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: last_posting_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent transaction posted to this GL account. Used for account activity monitoring and dormant account identification.

attributes.name: natural_expense_classification
attributes.description: The natural classification of expense by type (e.g., salaries, benefits, travel, supplies, professional fees, rent, utilities). Used alongside functional classification for comprehensive expense reporting per FASB ASC 958.

attributes.name: normal_balance_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account normally carries a debit or credit balance per double-entry accounting principles.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this GL account usage, restrictions, or compliance requirements.

attributes.name: posting_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions can be directly posted to this account (true for detail accounts) or if it is a summary/roll-up account that only receives aggregated balances (false).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting, Unit4 ERP

attributes.name: program_service_code
attributes.description: The program or service line code that this account supports (e.g., WASH, Health, Education, Emergency Response). Used for program-level financial reporting and Monitoring Evaluation and Learning (MEL).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 - Not-for-Profit Entities, IRS Form 990

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires regular reconciliation (e.g., bank accounts, accounts receivable, accounts payable control accounts). Used for internal control and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GAAP for Nonprofits, Internal Control Standards

attributes.name: sdg_alignment_code
attributes.description: The United Nations Sustainable Development Goal(s) that activities posted to this account contribute toward (e.g., SDG 1 - No Poverty, SDG 6 - Clean Water and Sanitation). Used for impact reporting.

attributes.name: tax_relevance_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the tax treatment of transactions posted to this account: taxable income, non-taxable, tax-exempt per IRS 501(c)(3) regulations, or not applicable.

attributes.name: unrelated_business_income_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue posted to this account constitutes Unrelated Business Income (UBI) subject to taxation under IRS regulations for tax-exempt organizations.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Transactional record of every GL journal entry posted in SAP S/4HANA or Unit4 ERP. Captures document number, posting date, fiscal period, fiscal year, document type (original, reversal, accrual, allocation), posting key, currency, exchange rate, reference document, posting user, approval status, reversal indicator, and source system. The foundational transactional entity for all financial reporting, audit trails, and GAAP-compliant fund accounting. Each journal entry has one or more journal_entry_line records.
products.reference: SAP FI Journal Entry / GAAP General Ledger Posting

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry record. Primary key for the journal entry entity.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the grant or award that this journal entry is financially associated with. Critical for grant-specific financial tracking, budget versus actual reporting, and donor reporting compliance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Grant Financial Management

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: journal_entry has no bank_account_id FK. Bank-related journal entries (bank reconciliation adjustments, bank charges, interest income) must reference the specific bank account they affect. Adding bank

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entries are allocated to cost centers at the header level. This FK enables cost center reporting and management analysis.

attributes.name: country_office_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.country_office. Business justification: Journal entries are often specific to a country office. Finance needs country-level expense tracking for management reporting, donor reporting, and HQ consolidation.

attributes.name: created_by_staff_member_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Created By Staff Member Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.staff_member. Business justification: Finance tracks which staff member created each journal entry for audit trail and accountability - fundamental accounting control requirement in nonprofit financial management.

attributes.name: field_deployment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.deployment. Business justification: Deployment costs are recorded via journal entries. Finance needs to link JEs to deployments for cost tracking, audit trail, and deployment cost analysis.

attributes.name: field_team_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.team. Business justification: Team operating costs are recorded via journal entries. Finance needs to link JEs to teams for team budget tracking and team cost analysis.

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_fund. Business justification: Journal entries are allocated to funds at the header level. This FK enables fund-level reporting and ensures compliance with donor restrictions.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Journal entries are posted to specific fiscal periods for financial reporting and period close processes. The existing fiscal_year (INT) and fiscal_period (INT) columns are denormalized representation

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the program or project that this journal entry supports. Enables program-level cost tracking, budget monitoring, and Results-Based Management (RBM) financial reporting.

attributes.name: project_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.project_site. Business justification: Many journal entries relate to specific field sites (site operating costs, site setup costs). Finance needs to track expenses by site for management reporting and site cost analysis.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry was approved for posting. Null if not yet approved. Part of the audit trail for approval workflow compliance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Internal Controls

attributes.name: audit_trail_notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments added for audit trail purposes, explaining unusual circumstances, supporting documentation references, or special handling instructions.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch identifier grouping multiple journal entries that were posted together as a single batch. Used for batch-level approval workflows and mass reversal operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA for Nonprofits - Batch Processing Standards

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity or company code within the ERP system to which this journal entry belongs. Essential for multi-entity nonprofit organizations with separate legal entities or country offices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA for Nonprofits - Organizational Structure

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Compliance status flag indicating whether this journal entry has been reviewed for regulatory compliance (OMB Uniform Guidance, FASB ASC 958, donor restrictions). Used for compliance monitoring and audit preparation.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the system. Foundational audit timestamp for record lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework - Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the transaction currency of this journal entry (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Essential for multi-currency grant accounting and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date the journal entry document was created or originated, which may differ from the posting date. Used for audit trail and document sequencing.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this journal entry in the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Unit4). Used for audit trails and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP for Nonprofits - Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry document type indicating the nature of the posting: original entry, reversal of prior entry, accrual for period-end, cost allocation, reclassification between accounts, or manual adjustment.

attributes.name: entry_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the business purpose and nature of this journal entry. Provides context for financial reviewers, auditors, and future reference.
attributes.references: GAAP for Nonprofits - Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency amounts to the organization's functional currency (typically USD). Null for entries in functional currency. Critical for multi-currency grant financial management.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Functional area classification (e.g., program services, management and general, fundraising) required for nonprofit functional expense reporting per FASB ASC 958. Supports Form 990 and donor reporting.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code for the organization's functional reporting currency. All journal entries are ultimately reported in this currency for consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.description: The Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement (NICRA) rate applied to this journal entry for facilities and administration (F&A) cost allocation. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 for 15%). Critical for federal grant compliance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Indirect Cost Rates

attributes.name: is_adjustment
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a manual adjustment or correction entry (as opposed to a system-generated or routine operational entry). True for adjustments; false for standard entries.
attributes.references: GAAP for Nonprofits - Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: is_inter_company
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an inter-company or inter-entity transaction requiring elimination in consolidated financial statements. True for inter-company entries; false otherwise.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Ledger group or ledger type identifier (e.g., leading ledger, extension ledger, parallel accounting ledger) used in systems supporting multiple parallel accounting views. Supports GAAP and IFRS parallel reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry was last modified. Null if never modified. Critical for audit trail and change history tracking.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework - Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The business date on which this journal entry was posted to the general ledger. This is the effective date for financial reporting and determines which fiscal period the entry impacts.
attributes.references: GAAP for Nonprofits - Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: System-specific posting key code (from SAP or Unit4) that determines the account type (debit/credit) and controls which fields are required during entry. Technical control field for ERP posting logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA for Nonprofits - Configuration Standards

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry in the approval and posting workflow. Tracks progression from draft creation through approval to final posting in the general ledger.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Internal Controls

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this journal entry to source documents such as invoices, payment vouchers, grant agreements, or other originating transactions. Supports audit trail and source document traceability.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previously posted entry. True if this entry reverses another entry; false otherwise.
attributes.references: GAAP for Nonprofits - Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this journal entry was reversed. Required for audit compliance and internal control documentation when reversal_indicator is true.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Internal Controls

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true. Maintains bidirectional audit trail for reversals.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the system or interface that originated this journal entry. Distinguishes between entries created directly in the ERP (SAP S/4HANA, Unit4), manual entries, or entries interfaced from subsidiary systems.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework - Source System Tracking

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit or credit line item within a GL journal entry. Captures line number, GL account, cost center, fund, grant reference, program code, debit or credit amount, functional expense category, natural account classification, tax code, profit center, and narrative description. Enables granular fund accounting, cost allocation, and grant financial reporting at the transaction line level per FASB ASC 958 and OMB Uniform Guidance.
products.reference: SAP FI Line Item / GAAP Journal Line

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for the journal entry line product.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grant or award that this line item is charged to. Enables grant financial management and compliance reporting per OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: budget_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the budget line item against which this actual expenditure or revenue is tracked. Enables Budget versus Actual (BvA) variance analysis.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Standards, OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entry lines are allocated to cost centers for expense tracking and management reporting. This FK enables joining to get cost center hierarchy, manager, and program area.

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_fund. Business justification: Journal entry lines are allocated to funds for fund accounting and donor restriction tracking. This FK enables joining to get fund type, restriction type, and donor information.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: journal_entry_line has fiscal_period (INT) and fiscal_year (INT) as raw scalar fields rather than a proper FK to fiscal_period. Adding fiscal_period_id normalizes this to reference the authoritative f

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Every journal entry line posts to a GL account. This is the core relationship for the general ledger. The FK enables joining to get account type, financial statement classification, and CoA hierarchy.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header that contains this line item. Links the line to its transaction header.

attributes.name: original_line_journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original journal entry line ID that this line reverses or corrects. Null if this is not a reversal. Supports audit trail and error correction tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier associated with this line item for accounts payable transactions. Supports vendor payment tracking and procurement compliance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Procurement Standards

attributes.name: allowable_cost_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this cost is allowable under the applicable grant or award terms per OMB Uniform Guidance. Used for grant financial compliance.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status of this journal entry line within the financial workflow. Tracks whether the line has been reviewed, approved, and posted to the GL.
attributes.references: Internal Controls Standards, GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry line was approved. Supports audit trails and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who approved this journal entry line. Supports internal controls and audit trails per OMB Uniform Guidance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Internal Controls Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry line record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The credit amount for this journal entry line in the functional currency. Null or zero if this is a debit line. Used for double-entry bookkeeping per GAAP.

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: The debit amount for this journal entry line in the functional currency. Null or zero if this is a credit line. Used for double-entry bookkeeping per GAAP.

attributes.name: direct_cost_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this line item represents a direct cost (true) or an indirect/overhead cost (false). Used for cost allocation and grant compliance.

attributes.name: donor_restriction_type
attributes.description: Classification of donor restrictions on the funds used in this line item per FASB ASC 958: unrestricted, temporarily restricted (time or purpose), or permanently restricted (endowment).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the transaction represented by this line item. May differ from posting date for accruals, deferrals, and period adjustments.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional currency in which the debit and credit amounts are denominated.
attributes.references: ISO 4217, FASB ASC 830 - Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: functional_expense_category
attributes.description: Classification of the expense by functional category as required by FASB ASC 958: program services, management and general, or fundraising. Used for Form 990 and donor reporting.

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.description: The Negotiated Indirect Cost Rate Agreement (NICRA) rate applied to this line item for Facilities and Administration (F&A) cost allocation per OMB Uniform Guidance.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, NICRA Standards

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this line item represents an intercompany or inter-entity transaction between organizational units or affiliated entities.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The vendor invoice number or internal invoice reference associated with this line item. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and audit trails.
attributes.references: GAAP for Nonprofits, Accounts Payable Standards

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the journal entry line item. Provides context and explanation for the transaction, supporting audit trails and financial transparency.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry, used for ordering and referencing individual line items within the parent entry.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this journal entry line. Supports audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry line record was last modified. Supports audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: natural_account_classification
attributes.description: The natural classification of the expense by type of expenditure (e.g., salaries, benefits, travel, supplies). Complements functional expense reporting per FASB ASC 958. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salary|benefits|travel|supplies|equipment|occupancy|professional_services — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The payment reference or check number associated with this line item for accounts payable or accounts receivable transactions. Supports cash reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP for Nonprofits, Cash Management Standards

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this journal entry line was posted to the general ledger. Used for period-end closing and financial reporting cutoff.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center or revenue-generating unit associated with this line item. Used for revenue attribution and financial performance analysis by business unit.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: The program or project code to which this line item is allocated. Supports program-level financial tracking and Results-Based Management (RBM) reporting.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this line item is a reversal or correction of a previous journal entry line. Used for audit trails and error correction tracking.

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the source document or transaction that generated this journal entry line (e.g., invoice ID, payroll batch ID, grant disbursement ID). Supports audit trails.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system or module from which this journal entry line originated (e.g., AP, AR, Payroll, Grant Management). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code or VAT code applicable to this line item. Used for tax compliance, reporting, and recovery in jurisdictions where the nonprofit operates.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this journal entry line. Supports audit trails and data lineage.

products.name: budget
products.description: Master budget record for an approved financial plan associated with a grant, program, cost center, or organizational unit. Captures budget code, budget name, budget type (operational, project, grant, capital), fiscal year, total approved amount, currency, budget status (draft, approved, revised, closed), approval date, approving authority, associated fund or grant reference, donor reference, direct cost budget, indirect cost budget, ICR rate applied, NICRA rate reference, budget period start and end dates, approved modifications, cost-share requirement amount, and BvA summary metrics (total actual expenditure, total variance, burn rate). For grant-type budgets, carries grant-specific compliance attributes per OMB 2 CFR 200 and donor requirements (USAID, DFID, UN) including award ceiling, cost-share obligations, and prior approval thresholds. The single SSOT for all approved budget baselines — operational, programmatic, and grant-specific — used in Budget vs. Actual tracking and donor financial reporting.
products.reference: Unit4 Budget Master / OMB 2 CFR 200 Budget Control

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget record. Primary key.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Budgets must include costs for compliance obligations (audit fees, external review costs, certification expenses). Budget planning requires identifying applicable obligations to ensure adequate fundin

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budgets are allocated to cost centers for budget vs. actual tracking. This FK enables joining to get cost center hierarchy, manager, and program area.

attributes.name: country_office_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.country_office. Business justification: Country office budgets are standard. Finance needs to track budgets by country office for country-level financial management and HQ consolidation.

attributes.name: donor_constituent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the donor or funding organization that provided the resources for this budget. Essential for donor-specific financial reporting and stewardship.

attributes.name: donor_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the fund associated with this budget. Links the budget to the fund accounting structure for restricted and unrestricted fund tracking per FASB ASC 958.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: budget has fiscal_year (STRING) as a scalar but no fiscal_period_id FK. Budget records must be anchored to specific fiscal periods for BvA tracking and period-end reporting. Adding fiscal_period_id li

attributes.name: grant_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the grant award record if this is a grant-type budget. Links the budget to the specific donor award for compliance tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: NGO budgets are owned and managed by org units; FK enables organizational budget reporting, accountability assignment, and supports consolidated financial planning across the org hierarchy — essential

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this budget was formally approved by the designated authority (e.g., Finance Director, Board of Directors, donor). Marks the transition from draft to approved status.

attributes.name: approved_modifications_count
attributes.description: The number of formal modifications or amendments that have been approved for this budget since initial approval. Tracks budget revision history and compliance with donor prior-approval requirements.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: The name or title of the individual or body that approved this budget (e.g., Chief Financial Officer, Executive Director, Board of Directors, Donor Program Officer).

attributes.name: award_ceiling_amount
attributes.description: The maximum allowable expenditure under the grant award, including all approved modifications. For grant-type budgets, this represents the donor's total funding commitment and cannot be exceeded without prior approval.

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying this budget in financial systems and donor reports. Used as the business identifier for budget tracking and reference.

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the budget, typically including program or grant reference for easy identification by finance and program staff.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the budget. Draft indicates initial preparation; submitted means under review; approved indicates formal authorization; revised indicates modifications post-approval; active indicates currently in use; closed indicates budget period ended; cancelled indicates budget was terminated before completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|revised|active|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by its purpose and funding nature. Operational budgets support ongoing organizational activities; project budgets are tied to specific initiatives; grant budgets are donor-funded and compliance-driven; capital budgets fund long-term assets; restricted budgets have donor-imposed limitations; unrestricted budgets have no donor restrictions.

attributes.name: burn_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total approved budget that has been expended to date. Calculated as (total_actual_expenditure / total_approved_amount) * 100. Used to monitor spending pace and forecast budget depletion.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing special compliance requirements, donor conditions, or restrictions specific to this budget (e.g., procurement rules, allowable cost categories, geographic restrictions). Used by finance and program staff to ensure adherence to donor terms.

attributes.name: cost_share_requirement_amount
attributes.description: The amount of cost-sharing or matching funds required by the donor as a condition of the grant. Represents the organization's commitment to contribute resources beyond the donor award.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: total_variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the total approved budget amount and the total actual expenditure. Positive variance indicates under-spending; negative variance indicates over-spending. Key metric for Budget vs. Actual (BvA) reporting.

attributes.name: allocation_basis_quantity
attributes.description: The quantitative measure of the allocation basis used in the calculation (e.g., number of employees, square feet, total direct costs). Used in conjunction with allocation_rate to compute allocated_amount.

attributes.name: allocation_basis_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the allocation basis quantity (e.g., employees, square_feet, USD, FTE, hours).

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the cost allocation was executed and recorded in the general ledger.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to distribute costs across grants, programs, or cost centers. Common methods include direct assignment, proportional distribution, NICRA-based rates, step-down allocation, activity-based costing, headcount-based, or square footage-based. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct|proportional|nicra_based|step_down|activity_based|headcount|square_footage — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context, justification, or documentation for this cost allocation transaction.

attributes.name: allocation_rate
attributes.description: The rate or percentage applied to the allocation basis to calculate the allocated amount. For NICRA-based allocations, this represents the negotiated indirect cost rate.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost allocation transaction: draft (being prepared), pending approval (awaiting review), approved (authorized), posted (recorded in GL), reversed (cancelled), or rejected (not approved).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost allocation was approved by the authorized financial manager or controller.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this cost allocation transaction.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this cost allocation to supporting documentation, audit logs, or source system transaction records for compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this cost allocation meets OMB Uniform Guidance and donor compliance requirements: compliant, non-compliant, under review, or exempt.

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: Classification of the cost being allocated: direct program costs, indirect costs, facilities and administration (F&A), shared services, or overhead.

attributes.name: cost_pool
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the cost pool from which costs are being allocated. Cost pools aggregate similar indirect costs for distribution.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost allocation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocated amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: is_fa_cost
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation represents Facilities and Administration (F&A) costs, also known as indirect costs, that are recoverable under federal grants.

attributes.name: is_restricted_fund
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the target fund is a restricted fund with donor-imposed limitations on the use of resources.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost allocation record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost allocation was posted to the general ledger and became part of the official financial records.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost allocation was reversed or cancelled, if applicable. Null if the allocation has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why this cost allocation was reversed or cancelled, if applicable.

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Master record for all organizational bank accounts managed by the NGO across headquarters, regional offices, and country offices. Captures bank account number (masked), bank name, bank branch, SWIFT/BIC code, IBAN, account currency, account type (operating, restricted, payroll, project, donor-specific), country, account status (active, dormant, closed), signatory requirements and thresholds, fund association for restricted accounts, GL reconciliation account reference, and reconciliation frequency. Supports multi-currency cash management, restricted fund segregation, donor ring-fencing requirements, and financial controls across global operations.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank account record. Primary key for the bank account entity.

attributes.name: country_office_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.country_office. Business justification: Bank accounts are owned and operated by country offices — a fundamental NGO treasury management relationship. office_location is a denormalized representation of the country office. Linking enables co

attributes.name: created_by_staff_member_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Created By Staff Member Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.staff_member. Business justification: Finance tracks which staff member created each bank account record for accountability in bank account setup and treasury management.

attributes.name: donor_constituent_id
attributes.description: FK to donor.constituent

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_fund. Business justification: Bank accounts are designated for specific funds (restricted or unrestricted). This FK enables joining to get fund restriction type, donor, and balance information.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Bank accounts map to GL accounts for financial reporting. This FK enables joining to get the GL account classification and financial statement mapping.

attributes.name: grant_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific grant award associated with this bank account, if the account is dedicated to a single grant or project. Supports grant financial management and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: statutory_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.statutory_registration. Business justification: NGO field office bank accounts are opened under a specific country statutory registration (legal entity). Linking bank_account to statutory_registration supports legal entity-level financial reporting

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The official name or title of the bank account as registered with the financial institution. Typically reflects the organization name, office, or fund designation.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The full bank account number as issued by the financial institution. May be masked for security purposes in reporting layers. Critical for payment processing, reconciliation, and fund transfers.
attributes.references: PCI DSS, OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: account_number_masked
attributes.description: Partially masked version of the bank account number for display in reports and user interfaces (e.g., ****1234). Protects sensitive financial data while allowing account identification.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bank account. Active accounts are operational for transactions; dormant accounts have no recent activity but remain open; closed accounts are permanently deactivated; frozen accounts are temporarily suspended due to compliance or security issues; pending activation accounts are newly opened but not yet operational.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account based on its operational purpose. Operating accounts support general organizational expenses; restricted accounts hold donor-restricted funds; payroll accounts are dedicated to staff compensation; project accounts are tied to specific grants or programs; donor-specific accounts are ring-fenced per donor requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operating|restricted|payroll|project|donor_specific|savings|escrow|petty_cash — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958, OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The available balance in the bank account, accounting for pending transactions, holds, and minimum balance requirements. Represents the actual funds available for disbursement. Denominated in the account currency.

attributes.name: bank_branch_code
attributes.description: The unique code assigned to the bank branch by the financial institution or national banking authority. Used for domestic payment routing and reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_branch_name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the specific bank branch where the account is domiciled. Supports localized banking operations and correspondence.

attributes.name: bank_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the primary contact person at the financial institution for this bank account. Used for correspondence and issue resolution.

attributes.name: bank_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary contact person at the financial institution for this bank account. Supports relationship management and issue resolution.

attributes.name: bank_contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the primary contact person at the financial institution for this bank account. Used for urgent inquiries and issue resolution.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the financial institution where the account is held. Essential for payment routing, reconciliation, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was officially closed. Null for active or dormant accounts. Marks the end of the account lifecycle.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The 3-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the bank account is domiciled. Supports geographic reporting, compliance monitoring, and regional cash management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bank account record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the denomination of the bank account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CHF). Critical for multi-currency cash management and foreign exchange tracking.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The current balance of the bank account as of the last update or reconciliation. Denominated in the account currency. Used for cash flow monitoring and liquidity management.

attributes.name: donor_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank account holds donor-restricted funds that can only be used for specific purposes as stipulated by the donor. True if restricted; false if unrestricted. Critical for FASB ASC 958 compliance and donor stewardship.

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: The International Bank Account Number, a standardized international numbering system for bank accounts. Used primarily in Europe and other regions for cross-border payments. Format varies by country but always starts with 2-letter country code followed by 2 check digits.

attributes.name: interest_bearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank account earns interest on deposited funds. True if interest-bearing; false otherwise. Relevant for savings accounts and certain restricted fund accounts.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate applied to this bank account, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.5%). Applicable only for interest-bearing accounts. Used for interest income forecasting and financial planning.

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was last successfully reconciled against the General Ledger (GL). Used to monitor compliance with reconciliation frequency requirements and identify overdue reconciliations.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent transaction (deposit, withdrawal, or transfer) on this bank account. Used to identify dormant accounts and monitor account activity.

attributes.name: minimum_balance_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum balance that must be maintained in this bank account to avoid fees or penalties, as stipulated by the financial institution. Denominated in the account currency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this bank account. May include donor stipulations, operational constraints, or historical context.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was officially opened with the financial institution. Marks the start of the account lifecycle.

attributes.name: overdraft_limit
attributes.description: The maximum overdraft amount permitted on this bank account, if overdraft protection is enabled. Denominated in the account currency. Null if no overdraft protection exists.

attributes.name: overdraft_protection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank account has overdraft protection enabled. True if overdraft protection is active; false otherwise. Overdraft protection allows transactions to proceed even if the account balance is insufficient, subject to bank terms.

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for reconciling this bank account against the General Ledger (GL). High-volume or high-risk accounts may require daily reconciliation; lower-activity accounts may be reconciled monthly or quarterly per internal controls policy.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The 9-digit routing transit number (RTN) used in the United States for domestic wire transfers, ACH transactions, and check processing. Identifies the financial institution in the US banking system.

attributes.name: signatory_requirement
attributes.description: The number and level of authorized signatories required to approve transactions on this bank account. Single signatory allows one authorized person; dual signatory requires two; triple requires three; board approval requires formal board resolution. Supports segregation of duties and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Controls Policy, OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: signatory_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The monetary threshold above which elevated signatory requirements apply. For example, transactions below this amount may require single signatory, while transactions above require dual or board approval. Denominated in the account currency.

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.description: The Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) code, also known as Bank Identifier Code (BIC). An 8 or 11-character code used for international wire transfers and cross-border payments. Format: 4-letter bank code, 2-letter country code, 2-character location code, optional 3-character branch code.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bank account record was last updated in the system. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: fiscal_period
products.description: Master reference table for fiscal_period. Referenced by fiscal_period_id.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Primary key for fiscal_period

attributes.name: primary_prior_year_period_fiscal_period_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Prior Year Period Fiscal Period Id
attributes.description: Reference to the corresponding fiscal period in the prior fiscal year. Enables year-over-year comparative analysis.

attributes.name: audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period requires external audit review, typically for annual periods or grant compliance.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: The date when the fiscal period was officially closed. Nullable if period is still open or future.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fiscal period record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_in_period
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days in the fiscal period. Used for prorations, accruals, and time-weighted calculations.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the fiscal period. Defines when the period closes for financial transactions and reporting.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_date
attributes.description: The date for which exchange rates are locked for multi-currency translation in this fiscal period. Nullable for single-currency organizations.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_description
attributes.description: Detailed description or notes about the fiscal period, including any special considerations, adjustments, or organizational context.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this period belongs (e.g., 2024). Supports non-calendar fiscal years common in nonprofit organizations.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period record is currently active and available for use in financial transactions and reporting.

attributes.name: is_adjustment_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a special adjustment period (typically Period 13) used for year-end closing entries and corrections.

attributes.name: is_year_end_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the final period of the fiscal year, requiring special year-end closing procedures and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: locked_date
attributes.description: The date when the fiscal period was permanently locked, preventing any further modifications. Nullable if not yet locked.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fiscal period record was last modified. Updated whenever period status or attributes change.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: The date when the fiscal period was officially opened for transaction posting. May differ from start_date due to administrative processes.

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the fiscal period (e.g., FY24-Q1, P01-2024). Used as a business identifier for reporting and reference.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the fiscal period (e.g., 'January 2024', 'Q1 FY2024', 'Period 1 - FY2024').

attributes.name: period_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the period within the fiscal year (e.g., 1 for January, 4 for Q1, 12 for December). Used for ordering and reporting.

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fiscal period. Open allows transactions; closed prevents new entries but allows adjustments; locked is final and immutable; future indicates not yet active.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fiscal period by duration and frequency (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, or custom).

attributes.name: quarter_number
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter number (1-4) to which this period belongs. Nullable for non-quarterly periods.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for financial reporting in this period (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency nonprofit operations.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the fiscal period. Defines when the period becomes effective for financial transactions and reporting.

attributes.name: working_days_in_period
attributes.description: Number of business working days in the fiscal period, excluding weekends and holidays. Used for operational metrics and staffing calculations.

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: SSOT for all staff and human resources data including employee records, payroll, benefits, talent acquisition, performance management, learning and development, and talent retention in Workday HCM. Covers national and international staff, expatriate management, field personnel, HRIS data, and RACI role assignments across programs.

products.name: staff_member
products.description: Core master record for all paid staff at Ngo, including national staff, international staff, expatriates, and field personnel. Captures full employee identity (name, date of birth, nationality, gender), employment classification, contract type, duty station, cost center assignment, emergency contact/next-of-kin details, and HRIS identifiers sourced from Workday HCM. Includes separation lifecycle attributes: separation type (resignation, end of contract, redundancy, termination, retirement, death in service), effective date, exit interview completion, final settlement amount, rehire eligibility, and separation reason narrative. Serves as the SSOT for workforce identity across all HR sub-domains, the anchor entity for all workforce transactions, and the single record of employment lifecycle from hire to separation.

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each staff member record in the Ngo workforce system. Primary key for the staff_member data product, serving as the anchor entity for all workforce transactions across HR sub-domains.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Object; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: staff_member is the core HR master record and currently stores job_title and job_grade as free-text strings. job_profile is the SSOT for standardized role definitions including job family, level, comp

attributes.name: supervisor_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff_member_id of this staff member's direct line manager. Enables organizational hierarchy traversal, RACI reporting, performance management workflows, and approval chain configuration in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Manager Hierarchy; RACI Framework; CHS Alliance Accountability Standards

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: The gross annual base salary of the staff member in the contract currency, as recorded in Workday HCM. Used for payroll processing, Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting, and grant cost allocation under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Compensation Allowability; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled expiry date of the staff member's current employment contract. Null for permanent/open-ended contracts. Used for contract renewal alerts, workforce planning, and grant-funded position management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract End Date; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Grant Period Alignment

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the staff member's current employment contract. May differ from hire_date for staff on renewed or amended contracts. Used for contract lifecycle management and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract Start Date; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: The legal nature of the employment arrangement. Determines statutory entitlements, benefits eligibility, payroll treatment, and compliance obligations under local labor law. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: permanent|fixed_term|consultancy|secondment|internship|volunteer_staff — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Contract Type; IRS 501(c)(3) Employment Classification; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The financial cost center code from the Chart of Accounts (CoA) to which the staff member's salary and benefits are charged. Enables Budget versus Actual (BvA) reporting and grant fund accounting per OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 cost allocation requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts (CoA); OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958 Fund Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the staff member record was first created in the Ngo data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data governance and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); FASB ASC 958 Audit Trail; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: The staff member's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for age verification, retirement planning, benefits eligibility, and visa/travel documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; IRS 401(k) Eligibility Rules; Workday HCM Personal Information

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The organizational department or division to which the staff member is assigned (e.g., Programs, Finance, MEAL, Logistics, HR, Communications). Used for organizational reporting, budget allocation, and RACI assignments.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization; SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Hierarchy; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: duty_station
attributes.description: The official location where the staff member is assigned to work, typically expressed as a city and country (e.g., Nairobi, KEN; Kabul, AFG). Used for hardship allowance calculation, security risk management, and field operations coordination per OCHA duty station classifications.
attributes.references: OCHA Duty Station Classification; UN Common System Hardship Allowances; Workday HCM Location

attributes.name: duty_station_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the staff member's duty station country. Used for geographic workforce analytics, country-level headcount reporting, and compliance with host-country labor laws.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Country Office Reporting; IATI Geographic Coding

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: The full name of the staff member's designated next-of-kin or emergency contact person. Used for critical incident notification, medical emergencies, and death-in-service protocols in field operations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; OCHA Critical Incident Management; CHS Alliance Staff Safety Standards

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: The telephone number of the staff member's designated emergency contact in E.164 international format. Used for critical incident notification and next-of-kin communication in field operations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; OCHA Critical Incident Management; CHS Alliance Staff Safety Standards

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the emergency contact to the staff member (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling). Used to contextualize next-of-kin notifications and legal next-of-kin determinations in death-in-service cases.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Emergency Contact; CHS Alliance Staff Safety; OCHA Critical Incident Protocols

attributes.name: employee_number
attributes.description: The human-readable, organization-assigned employee identification number used in payroll, HR correspondence, and access control systems. Distinct from the surrogate staff_member_id.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employee ID Field; IRS 501(c)(3) Payroll Compliance

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the staff member's employment at Ngo. Drives access control, payroll processing, and workforce headcount reporting. 'active' = currently employed and working; 'on_leave' = approved absence; 'suspended' = temporarily not working pending investigation; 'separated' = employment ended; 'probation' = within initial probationary period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employment Status; FASB ASC 958 Workforce Disclosures; CHS Alliance HR Standards

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member by geographic and operational deployment category. National staff are locally hired; international staff are deployed from another country; expatriates are on international assignment; field personnel are based in program delivery locations. Drives compensation bands, benefits packages, and NICRA cost allocation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS Chapter 302

attributes.name: exit_interview_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member completed an exit interview prior to or at separation. Used to track organizational learning compliance and ensure knowledge transfer processes are followed per CHS Core Humanitarian Standard accountability requirements.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; Workday HCM Offboarding Checklist; HAP Accountability Standards

attributes.name: final_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary amount paid to the staff member as final settlement upon separation, including any outstanding salary, accrued leave payout, severance, and gratuity as applicable under local labor law and contract terms.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Final Pay; Local Labor Law Severance Requirements; FASB ASC 958 Compensation Disclosures

attributes.name: fte_percentage
attributes.description: The proportion of full-time hours this staff member is contracted to work, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 100.00 for full-time, 50.00 for half-time). Used for headcount reporting, grant effort allocation, and Indirect Cost Rate (ICR/NICRA) calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM FTE; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Effort Reporting; NICRA Compliance

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The staff member's self-identified gender. Used for workforce diversity reporting, gender-disaggregated MEL indicators, and compliance with donor reporting requirements (e.g., USAID, DFID gender equity mandates).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9 (Special Category Data); USAID Gender Equality Policy; IATI Gender Marker; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the staff member commenced employment with Ngo, as recorded in Workday HCM. Used for service length calculations, benefits vesting schedules, probation period tracking, and anniversary-based entitlements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Hire Date; IRS W-2 Reporting; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to the staff member record in the Ngo data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); FASB ASC 958 Audit Trail; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: The staff member's legal given name as it appears on official government-issued identification documents. Used for payroll, visa, and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; IRS W-2 Reporting; IATI Staff Disclosure Standards

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: The staff member's legal family/surname as it appears on official government-issued identification documents. Used for payroll, visa, and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; IRS W-2 Reporting; IATI Staff Disclosure Standards

attributes.name: nationality
attributes.description: The staff member's nationality represented as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, GBR, KEN). Used for expatriate management, work permit tracking, and national vs. international staff classification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Humanitarian Staff Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: passport_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiry date of the staff member's passport. Used to trigger renewal alerts and ensure compliance with international travel and visa requirements for field deployments.
attributes.references: ICAO Travel Document Standards; OCHA Field Deployment Protocols; Workday HCM Document Tracking

attributes.name: passport_number
attributes.description: The staff member's passport number, required for international travel, visa applications, and expatriate deployment documentation. Stored securely in compliance with data protection regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; ICAO Travel Document Standards; OCHA Humanitarian Travel Protocols

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the staff member is paid (e.g., monthly, bi-weekly). Drives payroll cycle scheduling in Workday HCM and cash flow planning for field operations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Pay Group; IRS Payroll Compliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the staff member prefers to be addressed by in day-to-day operations, which may differ from their legal name. Used in internal communications, email display names, and staff directories.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Preferred Name Field; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard — Staff Dignity

attributes.name: probation_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff member's probationary period is scheduled to end. Used to trigger performance review workflows and confirm or terminate employment within the probation window.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Probation Period; Local Labor Law Compliance; CHS Alliance HR Standards

attributes.name: rehire_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member is eligible for rehire at Ngo following separation. Set to false for staff separated due to gross misconduct, fraud, or serious policy violations. Used during talent acquisition screening.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Rehire Eligibility; CHS Alliance HR Standards; Ngo HR Policy

attributes.name: salary_currency
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the staff member's base salary is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, KES). Required for multi-currency payroll consolidation and grant financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: separation_date
attributes.description: The effective date on which the staff member's employment with Ngo ended. Used for final payroll processing, benefits termination, access revocation, and workforce attrition reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Date; IRS W-2 Final Reporting; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: separation_reason
attributes.description: A free-text narrative describing the specific reason for the staff member's separation from Ngo. Complements the separation_type categorical field with contextual detail for HR records, exit documentation, and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Reason; CHS Alliance HR Standards; Local Labor Law Documentation

attributes.name: separation_type
attributes.description: The category of employment separation event for staff members whose employment has ended. Drives final settlement calculations, rehire eligibility determination, and statutory reporting. Values: resignation (voluntary), end_of_contract (fixed-term expiry), redundancy (position eliminated), termination (involuntary dismissal), retirement (age/service-based), death_in_service.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Type; IRS 501(c)(3) HR Compliance; Local Labor Law; CHS Alliance HR Standards

attributes.name: work_email
attributes.description: The official organizational email address assigned to the staff member. Primary digital contact channel for HR communications, system access provisioning, and donor/partner correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Workday HCM Contact Information; CHS Alliance Staff Communication Standards

attributes.name: work_permit_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiry date of the staff member's work permit or visa authorization. Used to trigger renewal workflows and ensure continuous legal authorization to work in the duty station country.
attributes.references: Host Country Labor Law; OCHA Humanitarian Staff Compliance; Workday HCM Document Tracking

attributes.name: work_permit_number
attributes.description: The work permit or visa authorization number for staff members who require legal authorization to work in their duty station country. Null for staff working in their country of nationality.
attributes.references: Host Country Labor Law; OCHA Humanitarian Staff Compliance; Workday HCM Document Tracking

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: The staff member's official work telephone number in E.164 international format. Used for operational communications, field coordination, and emergency contact protocols.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; GDPR Article 4; OCHA Field Communications Standards

attributes.name: workday_worker_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workday Human Resource Information System (HRIS) Worker ID
attributes.description: The unique worker identifier assigned by Workday HCM, used to cross-reference this record with the source system of record for all HR transactions, payroll, and benefits data.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Object; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

products.name: position
products.description: Authorized organizational position (headcount slot) within Ngos structure, distinct from the person filling it. Tracks position title, grade level, FTE allocation, funding source (grant or core), duty station, department, and whether the position is filled or vacant. Includes embedded job profile catalog: job family, job level, job function, competency requirements, minimum qualifications, pay grade band, and career progression path aligned with Workday HCM job catalog. Supports workforce planning, grant-funded headcount tracking, recruitment requisition creation, RACI role assignments, and organizational design.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for an authorized organizational position (headcount slot) within Ngo's structure. This is the primary key for the position entity in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Positions have mandatory compliance obligations (safeguarding-designated roles require specific certifications, field positions require security clearances). Enables role-based compliance tracking and

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budgeted positions are assigned to cost centers for headcount budgeting and functional expense planning; FK enables position-level cost center reporting essential for NGO organizational budget managem

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_fund. Business justification: Grant-funded positions require fund-level tracking for donor compliance and position budget management; FK enables fund-level headcount reporting and supports donor requirements for personnel cost tra

attributes.name: host_partner_org_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.partner_org. Business justification: NGOs create joint or co-funded positions hosted by partner organizations (embedded technical advisors, joint program coordinators). Linking positions to the host partner org enables tracking of partne

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the program or project to which this position is assigned. Enables grant-funded headcount tracking per program and supports RACI role assignments across programs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits Program Management; IATI Activity Standard

attributes.name: job_profile_id
