attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payroll run within Workday HCM. Progresses from draft through calculation, approval, and payment. Cancelled status indicates the run was voided before disbursement. Used for workflow control and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; CHS (Core Humanitarian Standard); FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the payroll run. Regular runs follow the standard pay schedule; off-cycle runs address missed payments; supplemental runs cover bonuses or allowances; correction runs fix prior errors; final runs process termination pay. Determines processing rules and audit requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: The aggregate of all deductions applied across employees in this payroll run, including statutory taxes, social security contributions, health insurance premiums, pension contributions, and voluntary deductions. Reconciled against payroll liabilities in the General Ledger (GL).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Workday HCM

attributes.name: total_employer_contributions
attributes.description: The aggregate employer-side payroll costs for this run, including employer social security, pension matching, health insurance, and other statutory employer contributions. Represents the full labor cost burden beyond gross pay, critical for grant budget management and F&A (Facilities and Administration) cost allocation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NICRA; Workday HCM

attributes.name: total_gross_pay
attributes.description: The aggregate gross earnings for all employees included in this payroll run before any deductions. Includes base salary, allowances, overtime, and other earnings components. Used for BvA (Budget versus Actual) reporting, grant cost allocation, and financial stewardship.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Workday HCM Payroll Module

attributes.name: total_net_pay
attributes.description: The aggregate net amount disbursed to all employees in this payroll run after all deductions. Equals total_gross_pay minus total_deductions. Used for cash disbursement planning, bank transfer reconciliation, and treasury management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP S/4HANA AP

attributes.name: total_tax_withheld
attributes.description: The aggregate income tax and statutory levies withheld from employee earnings in this payroll run. Reported to tax authorities and reconciled against payroll tax liability accounts in the CoA (Chart of Accounts). Supports compliance with IRS and local tax authority reporting.
attributes.references: IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; Local Tax Authority Standards; FASB ASC 958; Workday HCM

attributes.name: workday_run_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this payroll run by Workday HCM, the system of record. Enables traceability back to the source system for audit, reconciliation, and support purposes. Distinct from the Silver layer surrogate key payroll_run_id.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

products.name: payslip
products.description: Individual payslip record for each staff member per payroll cycle, serving as SSOT for both payroll run processing (pay period start/end dates, payroll group — national/international/expat, run sequence number, run status, batch approval, total run aggregates) and individual pay details (gross salary, allowances — housing/hardship/field/expat, statutory deductions — income tax/social security/pension, voluntary deductions, net pay in local and payment currencies). Multi-currency supported for international operations across 50+ countries. Includes payment method, bank details reference, and payroll run approval chain. Supports BvA (Budget vs Actual) payroll cost allocation to grants and programs, donor audit requirements, and statutory payroll reporting.

attributes.name: payslip_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual payslip record in the Workday HCM payroll system. Serves as the primary key for the payslip data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.award. Business justification: Effort certification and grant expenditure reporting (2 CFR 200, USAID ADS) require linking payslips to the funding award. 'grant_code' is a denormalized plain-text award reference. This FK enables ac

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Individual payslips are charged to cost centers for functional expense allocation and grant compliance; FK enables direct cost reporting per cost center and supports effort certification requirements.

attributes.name: employment_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employment_contract. Business justification: A payslip is generated based on the terms of an employment contract (base salary, allowances, deductions, salary grade). Linking payslip to employment_contract enables audit trails showing which contr

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_fund. Business justification: Payslips funded by specific grants require fund-level tracking for donor reporting and effort certification compliance; FK enables fund-level personnel cost reporting required by USAID, EU, and other

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Payslip salary components (gross pay, benefits, taxes) post to specific GL accounts; FK enables automated journal generation, financial statement accuracy, and direct audit trail from individual paysl

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Individual payslips are posted via journal entries; FK replaces the denormalized gl_journal_reference text field and provides direct audit trail from payslip to GL posting, essential for NGO financial

attributes.name: original_payslip_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payslip record that this corrected or reversed payslip supersedes. Null for standard payslips; populated only when is_correction is True, enabling full audit trail of payroll corrections.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll run batch under which this payslip was processed. Enables traceability of individual payslips back to the parent payroll run for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member for whom this payslip was generated. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM HRIS.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payroll run containing this payslip was formally approved in the Workday HCM approval workflow. Provides an auditable approval event timestamp for statutory and donor compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorising manager or finance officer who approved this payroll run in the Workday HCM approval chain. Supports RACI accountability documentation and donor audit requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Masked or tokenised reference to the employee's bank account details used for payment disbursement. Full account details are stored securely in Workday HCM; only a reference token is retained in the Silver Layer for audit traceability without exposing PCI-sensitive data.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; PCI DSS; GDPR Article 25 (Data Minimisation)

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the duty station where the employee is based and where payroll is processed. Determines applicable labour law, tax jurisdiction, statutory deduction rules, and local currency for multi-country NGO operations across 50+ countries.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payslip record was first created in the Workday HCM system and ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Provides the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: employer_pension_contribution
attributes.description: Employer's contribution to the employee's pension or provident fund for the pay period. Recorded separately from employee deductions for total employment cost reporting and grant cost allocation under OMB Uniform Guidance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Local Pension Regulations

attributes.name: employer_social_security
attributes.description: Employer's statutory social security or national insurance contribution associated with this payslip. Not deducted from employee pay but recorded for total employment cost reporting, BvA grant cost allocation, and NICRA indirect cost rate calculations.
attributes.references: Local Labour Law; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert local currency salary amounts to the payment currency at the time of payroll processing. Critical for multi-currency reconciliation and donor financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; IATI Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: expat_allowance
attributes.description: Allowance specific to internationally-recruited expatriate staff, covering relocation, cost-of-living differentials, and international assignment premiums. Applicable only to staff in the expat payroll group.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; INGO Expat Compensation Standards

attributes.name: field_allowance
attributes.description: Allowance paid to staff working in active field operations, remote areas, or humanitarian response zones. Distinct from hardship allowance; compensates for operational field conditions and mobility requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SPHERE Standards; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: gross_salary
attributes.description: Total gross salary amount in local currency before any deductions, representing the employee's base contractual pay for the pay period. Forms the basis for all statutory deduction calculations and BvA payroll cost reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: hardship_allowance
attributes.description: Additional allowance paid to staff deployed in hardship or non-family duty stations as classified by UN/INGO hardship classification frameworks. Compensates for difficult living conditions in humanitarian field operations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; UN Common System Hardship Classification; INGO HR Standards

attributes.name: housing_allowance
attributes.description: Monetary allowance paid to the employee to cover accommodation costs, commonly provided to international and expat staff in high-cost or insecure duty stations. Taxability varies by country and employment contract type.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; INGO Compensation Frameworks

attributes.name: income_tax_deduction
attributes.description: Statutory income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay in accordance with the applicable national tax legislation of the duty station country. Reported to tax authorities and included in statutory payroll filings.
attributes.references: IRS 501(c)(3) Regulations; Local Tax Authority Requirements; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: is_correction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payslip is a corrected reissue of a previously reversed payslip. When True, the original_payslip_id field references the superseded payslip for audit trail continuity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: is_off_cycle
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payslip was generated as part of an off-cycle payroll run (e.g., for a new hire mid-period, a termination payment, or a correction) rather than the standard scheduled payroll cycle.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the local currency in which the employee's salary components are denominated and calculated. Supports multi-currency payroll operations across 50+ countries.

attributes.name: net_pay_local
attributes.description: Final take-home pay amount in local currency after all statutory and voluntary deductions have been subtracted from gross pay and allowances. Represents the amount the employee is entitled to receive for the pay period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: net_pay_payment_currency
attributes.description: Net pay amount converted to the payment currency using the applicable exchange rate. Represents the actual amount disbursed to the employee's bank account. May equal net_pay_local when local and payment currencies are the same.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; ISO 4217; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the payroll period covered by this payslip. Together with pay_period_start_date defines the exact payroll cycle window for statutory and donor reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the payroll period covered by this payslip. Used for Budget vs Actual (BvA) payroll cost allocation to grants and programs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the currency in which net pay is actually disbursed to the employee. May differ from local_currency_code for expatriate staff paid in USD or EUR regardless of duty station.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; Workday HCM Payroll Module; INGO Expat Compensation Standards

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which net pay was disbursed to the employee's bank account or via the designated payment method. Represents the principal business event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee. Bank transfer is standard for most staff; cash and mobile money are used in remote field locations with limited banking infrastructure, common in humanitarian operations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; CHS Alliance Field Operations Standards

attributes.name: payroll_group
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member's employment category for payroll processing purposes. Determines applicable pay scales, allowances, tax treatment, and statutory deduction rules. National staff follow local labour law; international and expat staff follow INGO compensation frameworks.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; INGO HR Standards

attributes.name: payroll_run_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential run number within the payroll period (e.g., 1 for the primary run, 2 for a supplemental or correction run). Distinguishes regular payroll runs from off-cycle or adjustment runs.

attributes.name: payslip_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable unique reference number for this payslip, typically formatted as PSL-{COUNTRY}-{YEAR}-{MONTH}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in employee communications, statutory filings, and donor audit documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: payslip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this individual payslip record. Distinguishes between payslips that have been generated and issued to the employee versus those that have been reversed or superseded by a corrected payslip.

attributes.name: pension_deduction
attributes.description: Employee contribution to pension or provident fund deducted from gross pay. Includes both mandatory statutory pension contributions and voluntary supplementary pension scheme contributions where applicable.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Local Pension Regulations; GAAP for Nonprofits

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the humanitarian or development program to which this payroll cost is allocated. Supports program-level cost tracking for MEL reporting, LogFrame financial monitoring, and donor accountability.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Project Accounting; IATI Standard; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payroll run associated with this payslip. Tracks the workflow from initial calculation through approval, payment disbursement, and any reversals required for corrections.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: social_security_deduction
attributes.description: Statutory social security or national insurance contribution deducted from the employee's pay as required by local labour law. Varies by country and employment type; may be zero for certain expat staff under bilateral social security agreements.
attributes.references: Local Labour Law; GAAP for Nonprofits; Workday HCM Payroll Module

attributes.name: total_allowances
attributes.description: Sum of all allowance components (housing, hardship, field, expat, transport, and any other applicable allowances) for the pay period in local currency. Used as a subtotal in payslip presentation and BvA reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: total_statutory_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all mandatory statutory deductions (income tax, social security, pension) for the pay period. Used as a subtotal in payslip presentation and for statutory remittance reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958; Local Tax Authority Requirements

attributes.name: transport_allowance
attributes.description: Allowance paid to cover employee commuting or field transportation costs. Commonly provided to national staff in urban and peri-urban duty stations as part of the total compensation package.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Local Labour Law Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payslip record was last modified in the source system or Silver Layer. Tracks corrections, status changes, and reprocessing events for data lineage and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: voluntary_deductions
attributes.description: Total of all employee-elected voluntary deductions for the pay period, including staff association fees, health insurance premiums, loan repayments, savings scheme contributions, and other authorised deductions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FASB ASC 958

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Formal performance appraisal record for a staff member covering a defined review period. Captures review cycle (annual, mid-year, probation), overall rating, competency ratings, objective achievement scores, reviewer identity, reviewee acknowledgment, and development recommendations. Supports Ngo's talent retention and results-based management (RBM) culture.

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the performance review record. Primary key for the performance_review data product in the Workday HCM-sourced workforce domain.

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary grant funding the employee's position during the review period. Supports donor-funded staff performance reporting requirements under USAID, DFID, CERF, and OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Grant Financial Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID; DFID

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary humanitarian or development program to which the employee was assigned during the review period. Links performance outcomes to program results for RBM and donor reporting.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits Program Management; RBM Results-Based Management; IATI

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational position held by the employee at the time of the review, capturing role context for benchmarking and talent analytics.

attributes.name: primary_performance_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (reviewee) who is the subject of this performance review. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Object; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: reviewer_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (manager or designated reviewer) who conducted and submitted this performance review. Supports Results-Based Management (RBM) accountability chains.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management Module; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: accountability_rating
attributes.description: Rating assessing the employee's demonstrated accountability to affected populations and beneficiaries, a core CHS and HAP requirement for all humanitarian staff. Reflects adherence to feedback mechanisms and complaint handling.
attributes.references: CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4; HAP Humanitarian Accountability Partnership; Sphere Association

attributes.name: collaboration_rating
attributes.description: Rating for the collaboration and partnership competency, assessing the employee's effectiveness in working across teams, with partner organizations (CSOs, CBOs, INGOs), and with beneficiary communities.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency Framework; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: competency_rating_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score reflecting the employee's average rating across all behavioral competencies assessed in the review (e.g., leadership, collaboration, accountability, humanitarian principles). Supports talent development analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency Framework; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 8

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the performance review record was first created in the system (Workday HCM or the Databricks Silver Layer ingestion). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: development_recommendations
attributes.description: Structured recommendations from the reviewer for the employee's professional development, including suggested training, mentoring, stretch assignments, or Learning Management System (LMS) courses to address identified gaps.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning Module; LMS Learning Management System; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 8

attributes.name: duty_station
attributes.description: The geographic location (country, city, or field base) where the employee was deployed during the review period. Critical for field operations context, hardship allowance eligibility, and OCHA/USAID/BHA donor reporting.
attributes.references: OCHA Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs; USAID Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance (BHA); Workday HCM Location

attributes.name: duty_station_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the employee was stationed during the review period. Enables geographic workforce analytics and cross-country performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI International Aid Transparency Initiative; OCHA

attributes.name: employee_acknowledged
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has formally acknowledged the performance review in Workday HCM. Required for HR audit compliance and CHS accountability to affected populations standards.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Review Acknowledgment; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4; HAP

attributes.name: employee_acknowledged_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reviewed employee formally acknowledged receipt and review of their performance appraisal in Workday HCM. Required for HAP and CHS accountability compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management Module; HAP Humanitarian Accountability Partnership; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments submitted by the employee at the time of acknowledgment, capturing their response to the review outcome, including any disagreements, additional context, or commitments for the next period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Review; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4

attributes.name: employee_disagreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee formally disputed or disagreed with the performance review outcome. Triggers the HR grievance and appeals process in accordance with organizational HR policy and CHS accountability standards.
attributes.references: CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4; HAP Humanitarian Accountability Partnership; IRS 501(c)(3) HR Compliance

attributes.name: employee_self_assessment
attributes.description: Free-text self-assessment narrative submitted by the employee prior to the review meeting, documenting their own perspective on achievements, challenges, and development needs during the review period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Review Self-Evaluation; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the performance review record was most recently modified in the system. Tracks the full edit history for audit compliance and data quality monitoring in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: leadership_rating
attributes.description: Rating for the leadership competency dimension, assessing the employee's ability to guide teams, make decisions under pressure, and drive program outcomes in humanitarian field contexts.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency Framework; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 8

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The planned date for the employee's next performance review or check-in, as agreed during the current review meeting. Supports proactive HR scheduling and talent management planning.

attributes.name: objective_achievement_score
attributes.description: Composite percentage score (0–100) reflecting the degree to which the employee achieved their defined performance objectives during the review period. Derived from individual objective ratings in Workday HCM and used in RBM and LogFrame reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Goals Management; RBM Results-Based Management; LogFrame Logical Framework

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: The holistic performance rating assigned to the employee for the review period, reflecting the reviewer's consolidated assessment across all competencies and objectives. Drives talent retention, promotion, and RBM reporting decisions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Rating Scale Configuration; FASB ASC 958; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: overall_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score corresponding to the overall performance rating on the configured rating scale (e.g., 1.00–5.00). Enables quantitative talent analytics, benchmarking, and Results-Based Management (RBM) reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Rating Scale; RBM Results-Based Management Framework

attributes.name: pip_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) has been recommended or initiated as a result of this review, typically triggered by an unsatisfactory or needs_improvement overall rating.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management; IRS 501(c)(3) HR Compliance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: promotion_recommendation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer recommends the employee for promotion or advancement to a higher grade or responsibility level based on this review cycle's performance outcomes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: rating_scale_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the performance rating scale applied in this review (e.g., 'v2.1-2024'). Ensures historical comparability as rating scales evolve over time.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Rating Scale Configuration

attributes.name: retention_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer or HR has flagged this employee as at risk of leaving the organization, enabling proactive talent retention interventions. Supports NGO workforce stability in high-turnover humanitarian contexts.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 8

attributes.name: review_cycle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the performance review cycle that this appraisal belongs to. Distinguishes annual appraisals, mid-year check-ins, probationary reviews, end-of-contract assessments, and ad hoc reviews triggered by specific events.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Review Cycle Configuration; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 8

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the performance review must be completed and submitted by the reviewer. Used for HR compliance tracking and manager accountability reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management Module; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: review_meeting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal performance review discussion meeting took place between the reviewer and the employee. Distinct from the submission date; required for CHS accountability documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 4

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the performance review record (e.g., PR-2024-000123). Used in HR correspondence, audit trails, and donor-funded program compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Management Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the performance period being evaluated in this review. Together with review_period_start_date, defines the full appraisal window.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Period Configuration; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the performance period being evaluated in this review. Defines the temporal boundary for objective achievement and behavioral observation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Period Configuration; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the performance review workflow in Workday HCM. Tracks progression from draft through manager completion to employee acknowledgment and final closure.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Business Process Framework; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: review_submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reviewer formally submitted the completed performance review in Workday HCM. Used to measure timeliness compliance against the review due date.

attributes.name: reviewer_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text qualitative narrative provided by the reviewer summarizing the employee's performance, key achievements, areas for improvement, and behavioral observations during the review period. Confidential HR record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Performance Review; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's staff category at the time of the review. Distinguishes national staff, international staff, expatriates, consultants, and volunteers, which affects applicable HR policies, review templates, and donor reporting requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type Configuration; OCHA Humanitarian Workforce Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: technical_skills_rating
attributes.description: Rating for the employee's technical competency relevant to their functional role (e.g., MEAL methodology, WASH engineering, GBV case management, financial stewardship, ICT4D). Supports targeted learning and development planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Competency Framework; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; IATI International Aid Transparency Initiative

attributes.name: values_alignment_rating
attributes.description: Rating assessing the degree to which the employee demonstrates alignment with the NGO's core organizational values and humanitarian principles (e.g., humanity, neutrality, impartiality, accountability). Critical for CHS compliance and organizational culture.
attributes.references: CHS Core Humanitarian Standard; Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards; HAP Humanitarian Accountability Partnership

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Staff leave request and approval record capturing leave type (annual, sick, maternity/paternity, R&R, compassionate, TOIL), requested start date, end date, number of days, approval status, approver, and actual dates taken. Tracks leave balances and entitlements per staff member and supports field rotation and R&R scheduling for humanitarian staff.

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each leave request record in the Workday HCM system. Serves as the primary key for the leave_request data product.

attributes.name: approver_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or HR officer responsible for approving or rejecting this leave request. Supports RACI role assignments and delegation of authority tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: employment_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employment_contract. Business justification: A leave request is governed by the terms of a specific employment contract — leave entitlements, RnR cycle eligibility, and carry-forward rules are all defined at the contract level. Adding employment

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Leave requests are associated with the staff member's organizational unit for headcount planning, leave coverage management, and cost allocation. Adding org_unit_id normalizes the cost_center_code den

attributes.name: primary_leave_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member submitting the leave request. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM covering national staff, international staff, and expatriate personnel.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Human Capital Management; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: actual_days_taken
attributes.description: Number of working days actually taken by the staff member. Populated upon return from leave and used to update leave balance entitlements. Supports half-day precision.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the staff member returned from leave. May differ from requested_end_date due to early return, extension, or operational recall.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the staff member commenced their approved leave. May differ from requested_start_date due to operational adjustments or late approvals.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the leave request lifecycle in Workday HCM. Tracks progression from initial submission through managerial review to final decision or cancellation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approver made the final approval or rejection decision on the leave request. Null if the request is still pending or in draft state.

attributes.name: approver_comments
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the approving manager or HR officer when approving, rejecting, or modifying the leave request. Supports audit trail and communication.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the leave request was cancelled or withdrawn, either by the employee or by HR. Null if the request was not cancelled.

attributes.name: carry_forward_days
attributes.description: Number of unused leave days carried forward from the previous leave year that are being applied to this request. Subject to organizational carry-forward policy limits.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the leave request record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: duty_station_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the staff member's duty station at the time of the leave request. Determines applicable leave policy, public holiday calendar, and R&R eligibility for field staff.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; OCHA Field Operations

attributes.name: emergency_contact_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member has confirmed they can be reached in an emergency during their leave period. Particularly relevant for field staff and humanitarian response contexts.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; OCHA Field Operations

attributes.name: entitlement_days
attributes.description: Total number of days the staff member is entitled to for the applicable leave type in the current leave year, as defined by their contract, grade, and duty station policy.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: handover_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member has completed a formal handover of duties and responsibilities before commencing leave. Critical for field operations continuity and program delivery.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: is_retroactive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request was submitted after the leave period had already commenced or concluded (retroactive entry). Flags exceptions for HR compliance review and audit.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: is_rnr_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member is eligible for Rest and Recuperation (R&R) leave based on their duty station hardship classification. True for staff posted to hardship or non-family duty stations per OCHA/UNDSS security phase criteria.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Operations; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the leave request record, including status changes, date amendments, or approver updates.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: leave_balance_after
attributes.description: The staff member's remaining leave balance (in days) for the applicable leave type after the leave has been taken and confirmed. Updated upon return from leave.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: leave_balance_before
attributes.description: The staff member's available leave balance (in days) for the applicable leave type at the time the request was submitted. Enables entitlement validation and balance tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: leave_destination_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the staff member will spend their leave. Required for R&R and annual leave for international/expatriate staff for security tracking and travel authorization.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Field Operations; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: leave_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the staff member for the leave request. May contain sensitive personal information (e.g., medical, family). Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; GDPR Article 9; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leave being requested. Covers standard humanitarian workforce leave categories: Annual (vacation), Sick, Maternity/Paternity, Rest and Recuperation (R&R) for field staff, Compassionate (bereavement/family emergency), and Time Off In Lieu (TOIL) for overtime compensation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: leave_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year to which this leave request applies (e.g., 2024). Used for annual entitlement tracking, carry-forward calculations, and year-end reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: medical_certificate_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required medical certificate has been received and verified by HR. Relevant for sick leave requests where documentation is mandatory per organizational policy.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: medical_certificate_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical certificate is required for this leave request based on leave type and duration policy (e.g., sick leave exceeding 3 consecutive days). Drives compliance workflow in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the program or project to which the staff member's time is allocated during the leave period. Supports grant financial management and indirect cost rate (ICR/NICRA) calculations.
attributes.references: Unit4 ERP Project Accounting; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Standard

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Structured or free-text reason provided by the approver when rejecting a leave request. Required for rejected requests to support employee relations and grievance management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the leave request (e.g., LR-2024-000123). Used in correspondence, approvals, and audit trails.

attributes.name: requested_days
attributes.description: Number of working days requested for the leave period, as submitted by the employee. Supports half-day increments (e.g., 0.5). Excludes weekends and public holidays per the applicable country calendar.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: requested_end_date
attributes.description: The date the staff member has requested their leave to end (inclusive). Combined with requested_start_date to determine the requested duration.

attributes.name: requested_start_date
attributes.description: The date the staff member has requested their leave to begin. Used for scheduling, coverage planning, and field rotation management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: rnr_cycle_days
attributes.description: The number of days between R&R breaks applicable to the staff member's duty station (e.g., 42 days, 56 days, 84 days). Determined by the hardship classification of the duty station.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Operations; SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC)

attributes.name: security_clearance_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member's travel to the leave destination has been cleared by the security team. Required for international staff and field personnel traveling to or from high-risk areas.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Operations; UNDSS Security Management; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member's employment category at the time of the leave request. Determines applicable leave policy, entitlement rules, and R&R eligibility. National staff, international staff, and expatriates may have different leave frameworks.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Human Capital Management; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS); SPHERE Humanitarian Standards

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the staff member formally submitted the leave request in Workday HCM. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the transaction lifecycle.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: supporting_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or file path to supporting documentation attached to the leave request (e.g., medical certificate for sick leave, death certificate for compassionate leave). Stored in the document management system.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: toil_hours_accrued
attributes.business_glossary_term: Time Off In Lieu (TOIL) Hours Accrued
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours accrued by the staff member that are being converted to Time Off In Lieu (TOIL). Applicable only for TOIL leave type requests. Supports overtime compensation tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Leave Management Module; FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: workday_leave_request_reference
attributes.description: The native leave request identifier from the Workday HCM source system. Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.

products.name: staff_assignment
products.description: Record of a staff members assignment to a specific program, project, grant, or field operation, capturing assignment type (primary, secondary, surge deployment, TDY/temporary duty), percentage of time allocated, funding source (grant code), duty station, start date, end date, and RACI role (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed). Enables time-based payroll cost allocation to grants, supports donor-compliant effort reporting, and tracks RACI role assignments across programs for accountability matrices.

attributes.name: staff_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each staff assignment record in Workday HCM. Serves as the primary key for the staff_assignment data product.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.partnership_agreement. Business justification: Staff costs charged under partnership agreements must be traceable to the specific agreement for donor reporting, effort certification, and audit compliance. This direct link supports IATI reporting a

attributes.name: award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grant funding this assignment. Used for donor-compliant effort reporting and payroll cost allocation to the correct funding source per OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Unit4 ERP — Grant Financial Management

attributes.name: budget_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget_line. Business justification: Staff assignments consume specific budget lines for personnel costs; FK enables effort certification, budget vs. actual personnel cost tracking, and NICRA compliance reporting — fundamental for NGO gr

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Staff assignments drive cost center charges for effort certification and NICRA compliance; FK enables direct linkage between staff effort allocation and cost center financial reporting, a core NGO gra

attributes.name: country_office_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic duty station or field office where the staff member is deployed for this assignment. Supports field operations tracking and hardship/hazard pay calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Location; OCHA Field Operations Standards

attributes.name: donor_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.donor_requirement. Business justification: Donor agreements include key personnel clauses and nationality/qualification requirements for assigned staff. NGO grants management requires verifying each staff assignment satisfies applicable donor

attributes.name: emergency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.emergency. Business justification: Surge and emergency response staff assignments are made against specific declared emergencies. Donor accountability reports, emergency response plans, and HR surge capacity tracking all require linkin

attributes.name: employment_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employment_contract. Business justification: A staff assignment is governed by a specific employment contract — the contract defines the terms under which the staff member is deployed (salary, allowances, contract type). Adding employment_contra

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_fund. Business justification: Staff assignments are funded by specific grants/funds; FK enables fund-level effort tracking and donor-required effort certification reporting, critical for USAID and other institutional donor complia

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the humanitarian or development program to which the staff member is assigned. Enables program-level workforce planning and MEL accountability mapping.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Program Management

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: A staff assignment captures the role being performed during the assignment period. job_profile is the SSOT for role definitions including competencies, pay grade, and responsibilities. Adding job_prof

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Staff assignments to programs, projects, or grants should reference the organizational unit for proper cost allocation, reporting hierarchy, and matrix management visibility. While staff_assignment ha

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partnership.partner_org. Business justification: NGOs regularly deploy staff to partner organizations (technical assistance, secondments, embedded advisors). Linking staff assignments to the partner org enables tracking of partner-deployed staff, lo

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational position or job profile associated with this assignment in Workday HCM. Determines the role title, grade, and compensation band applicable to the assignment.

attributes.name: primary_workforce_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member record in the workforce master data. Links the assignment to the individual employee or contractor being assigned.

attributes.name: project_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific project or sub-component within a program to which the staff member is assigned. Supports project-level cost allocation and effort reporting.

attributes.name: tertiary_workforce_approved_by_staff_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (typically HR manager or program director) who approved this assignment in Workday HCM. Supports authorization audit trails and accountability documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Approval Workflow; Internal Audit Standards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff assignment was formally approved through the Workday HCM business process workflow. Marks the transition from 'draft' to 'active' status and establishes the authorization audit trail.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Business Process Approval; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: assignment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this staff assignment, used in donor reports, effort certification forms, and cross-system references (e.g., ASN-2024-WASH-001). Sourced from Workday HCM assignment reference number.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Assignment Reference; IATI Activity Standard

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or operational notes related to this staff assignment. May include information on acting capacity, special donor conditions, or field-specific requirements not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the staff assignment record. 'draft' indicates pending approval; 'active' indicates currently deployed; 'on_hold' indicates temporarily suspended; 'completed' indicates successfully concluded; 'cancelled' indicates terminated before completion.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Business Process Status; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the staff assignment. 'primary' indicates the main assignment; 'secondary' indicates a concurrent partial assignment; 'surge_deployment' indicates emergency response deployment; 'tdy' (Temporary Duty) indicates short-term field deployment; 'secondment' indicates inter-agency placement; 'consultant' indicates contracted technical assistance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Assignment Category; OCHA Surge Capacity Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this staff assignment record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with record-keeping requirements under OMB Uniform Guidance and IATI transparency standards.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; IATI Transparency Standard; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: duty_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the staff member is deployed for this assignment (e.g., 'SSD' for South Sudan, 'HTI' for Haiti). Used for hardship classification, tax treaty application, and OCHA country-level reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OCHA Country Operations; IATI Country Code Standard

attributes.name: effort_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment requires periodic effort certification by the staff member or supervisor (True), as mandated for federally-funded grants under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430. Drives the effort certification workflow in the GMS.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430; USAID ADS 591

attributes.name: effort_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of the staff member's total working time allocated to this specific assignment, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 50.00 for 50%). Must sum to 100% across all active assignments for a staff member. Critical for donor-compliant effort reporting and payroll cost allocation to grants per OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430 (Standards for Documentation of Personnel Expenses); USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff member's assignment concludes. Nullable for open-ended assignments. Used to determine assignment duration, payroll allocation periods, and grant charge eligibility windows.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Assignment End Date; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430

attributes.name: fte_equivalent
attributes.description: The full-time equivalent value of this assignment, calculated as effort_percent / 100. For example, a 50% assignment equals 0.50 FTE. Used for workforce capacity planning, budget forecasting, and donor reporting on staffing levels.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — FTE; FASB ASC 958 (Not-for-Profit Entities); IATI Activity Standard

attributes.name: funding_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the funding source underwriting this assignment. Determines applicable compliance requirements: 'federal_grant' triggers OMB Uniform Guidance; 'bilateral_donor' (e.g., USAID, DFID) triggers donor-specific reporting; 'cost_share' indicates matching contribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: federal_grant|private_grant|bilateral_donor|multilateral_donor|unrestricted_funds|cost_share — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS 303; IATI Standard

attributes.name: grant_code
attributes.description: The donor-assigned grant or award code to which payroll costs for this assignment are charged. Used in the Chart of Accounts (CoA) for fund accounting and donor financial reporting. Aligns with the grant identifier in SAP S/4HANA and Unit4 ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Fund Accounting; Unit4 ERP — Grant Financial Management; FASB ASC 958-605; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: hardship_level
attributes.description: The UN/ICSC hardship classification level for the duty station of this assignment (A=normal; B=some hardship; C=hardship; D=extreme hardship; E=unaccompanied). Determines hardship allowance entitlements and R&R (Rest and Recuperation) schedules for international and expatriate staff.
attributes.references: UN International Civil Service Commission (ICSC) Hardship Classification; OCHA Field Security Standards

attributes.name: is_cost_shared
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payroll costs for this assignment are shared across multiple grants or funding sources (True). When True, the effort_percent and grant_code fields define the primary allocation, and supplementary cost-share records exist for the remaining allocation.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.306 (Cost Sharing); USAID ADS 303

attributes.name: is_field_deployment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment involves deployment to a field or humanitarian response location (True) as opposed to a headquarters or regional office posting (False). Used to trigger field-specific HR policies, security protocols, and allowance calculations.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Operations Framework; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard

attributes.name: is_surge_deployment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment is classified as a surge deployment in response to an acute humanitarian emergency (True). Surge deployments trigger expedited onboarding, emergency per diem rates, and OCHA SitRep staffing reporting.
attributes.references: OCHA Surge Capacity Framework; IASC Emergency Response Protocols

attributes.name: last_effort_certified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent effort certification was completed and approved for this assignment. Used to track compliance with periodic effort reporting requirements under OMB Uniform Guidance and donor agreements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430; USAID ADS 591

attributes.name: raci_role
attributes.description: The RACI role assigned to the staff member for this program or project assignment. 'responsible' indicates the person doing the work; 'accountable' indicates the person ultimately answerable for outcomes; 'consulted' indicates subject matter experts providing input; 'informed' indicates stakeholders kept up to date. Supports accountability matrices and governance documentation.
attributes.references: RACI Framework; CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; IASC Accountability Framework

attributes.name: safeguarding_training_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member has completed mandatory safeguarding and protection training prior to or during this assignment (True). Required by CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard and donor compliance frameworks for all field deployments.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance Core Humanitarian Standard; Charity Commission (UK) Safeguarding; IASC PSEA (Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse) Standards

attributes.name: security_clearance_level
attributes.description: The security clearance level required and held by the staff member for this assignment. Relevant for assignments in conflict-affected or high-security environments. 'classified' indicates government-level clearance for assignments with bilateral donors such as USAID or DFID.
attributes.references: OCHA Field Security Framework; USAID Security Requirements; Charity Commission (UK) Safeguarding Standards

attributes.name: staff_category
attributes.description: Classification of the staff member's employment category for this assignment. Determines applicable HR policies, compensation structures, tax treatment, and donor reporting requirements. 'expatriate' indicates internationally-recruited staff deployed outside home country; 'national_staff' indicates locally-recruited personnel.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Worker Type; INGO HR Standards; OCHA Humanitarian Personnel Framework

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff member's assignment to the program, project, or field operation begins. Used for payroll cost allocation period calculations and effort reporting compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Assignment Effective Date; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 §200.430

attributes.name: tdy_purpose
attributes.description: Description of the business purpose for a Temporary Duty (TDY) assignment, such as 'emergency response support', 'capacity building mission', or 'program assessment'. Required for TDY travel authorization and donor reporting. Applicable only when assignment_type = 'tdy'.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Travel Authorization; USAID ADS 522 (Travel); OCHA Field Operations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this staff assignment record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Last Modified Date; Internal Audit Standards; IATI Transparency Standard

attributes.name: workday_assignment_ref
attributes.description: The source system reference identifier for this assignment record in Workday HCM. Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation, audit, and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Worker Assignment Reference ID

domains.name: compliance
domains.description: Manages regulatory filing, statutory reporting, and organizational accountability obligations. Covers IRS 501(c)(3) filings, Charity Commission returns, IATI transparency reporting, CHS self-assessments, HAP accountability frameworks, Single Audit requirements for US federal awards, and organizational governance documentation.

products.name: regulatory_filing
products.description: Master record of all statutory and regulatory filings including full submission audit trail. Covers IRS Form 990, Charity Commission annual returns, state charitable solicitation registrations, and foreign agent registration filings. Tracks filing type, jurisdiction, due date, submission date, channel (electronic/paper/portal), confirmation number, status lifecycle (draft → submitted → acknowledged → accepted/rejected), preparer, reviewer, filing period, rejection reason codes, and resubmission history. Each submission attempt is recorded for complete audit trail.
products.reference: IRS Form 990 / Charity Commission Annual Return

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory filing record. Primary key for the regulatory filing entity.

attributes.name: country_office_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.country_office. Business justification: Regulatory filings are submitted by specific country offices to host government authorities (annual NGO reports, tax filings). Linking regulatory_filing to country_office is fundamental for compliance

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Each regulatory filing satisfies a specific compliance obligation from the master obligation catalog. One filing is for one obligation; one obligation generates many filings over time (recurring oblig

attributes.name: original_filing_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original regulatory filing record that this amendment corrects or supersedes. Null if this is an original filing.

attributes.name: statutory_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.statutory_registration. Business justification: Regulatory filings are often associated with specific statutory registrations (e.g., annual charity returns for a registration, IRS 990 for a 501(c)(3) registration). One filing is for one registratio

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority formally accepted the filing as complete and compliant. Marks successful completion of the filing obligation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 4163; Charity Commission Processing Standards

attributes.name: acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority acknowledged receipt of the filing. Confirms that the submission was received and entered into the processing queue.
attributes.references: IRS e-file Acknowledgment Process; Charity Commission Receipt Confirmation

attributes.name: amendment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this filing is an amendment or correction of a previously submitted filing. True if this is an amended return, false if original filing.
attributes.references: IRS Form 990 Instructions Part I Line 1; Charity Commission Amendment Process

attributes.name: authorized_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual authorized to sign and submit the regulatory filing on behalf of the organization. Typically an officer or director with legal authority.
attributes.references: IRS Form 990 Signature Block; Charity Commission Declaration Requirements

attributes.name: authorized_signatory_title
attributes.description: Official title or position of the authorized signatory. Examples include Executive Director, Board Chair, President, or Chief Executive Officer (CEO).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this regulatory filing record was first created in the system. Marks the beginning of the filing lifecycle for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: Web address or file path where the submitted filing document is stored for retrieval and audit purposes. May point to internal document management system or external regulatory portal.
attributes.references: Document Management Standards; Electronic Records Retention Policy

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Statutory or regulatory deadline by which the filing must be submitted to avoid penalties or loss of status. Calculated based on fiscal year end and jurisdiction-specific rules.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 557; Charity Commission CC17a; State Charitable Solicitation Laws

attributes.name: extended_due_date
attributes.description: New filing deadline after an approved extension. Replaces the original due date for compliance tracking purposes.

attributes.name: extension_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the requested filing deadline extension was granted by the regulatory authority. True if extension was approved, false if denied or not applicable.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8868 Approval; Charity Commission Extension Decisions

attributes.name: extension_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an extension of the filing deadline was requested from the regulatory authority. True if extension was requested, false otherwise.
attributes.references: IRS Form 8868; Charity Commission Extension Guidance

attributes.name: filing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Monetary fee charged by the regulatory authority for processing the filing. Amount in the organizations functional currency.
attributes.references: State Charitable Solicitation Fee Schedules; Charity Commission Fee Guidance

attributes.name: filing_fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the filing fee amount. Examples include USD, GBP, EUR.

attributes.name: filing_fee_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the filing fee was paid to the regulatory authority. Used to confirm payment and avoid processing delays.
attributes.references: Accounts Payable Records; Payment Confirmation Standards

attributes.name: filing_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal notes, comments, or special circumstances related to the filing. Used to document unusual situations, preparer communications, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier or confirmation number assigned by the regulatory authority or filing system upon submission. Examples include IRS e-file confirmation number, Charity Commission submission reference, or state registration number.

attributes.name: filing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the fiscal or reporting period covered by this regulatory filing. Defines the conclusion of the time span for which financial and operational data are reported.

attributes.name: filing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the fiscal or reporting period covered by this regulatory filing. Defines the beginning of the time span for which financial and operational data are reported.

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory filing. Tracks progression from initial draft through submission, acknowledgment, and final acceptance or rejection by the regulatory authority. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|acknowledged|accepted|rejected|resubmitted|withdrawn|pending_review — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS e-file Status Codes; Charity Commission Filing Workflow

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this regulatory filing record was most recently updated. Tracks all changes throughout the filing lifecycle from draft to final acceptance.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; Change Tracking Requirements

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or firm responsible for preparing the regulatory filing. May be internal staff or external consultant/accountant.
attributes.references: IRS Form 990 Part XI; Professional Standards for Tax Preparers

attributes.name: preparer_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization or firm employing the preparer, if applicable. Identifies external accounting firms, consultancies, or legal advisors engaged to prepare the filing.
attributes.references: IRS Form 990 Part XI; Professional Services Engagement Standards

attributes.name: preparer_ptin
attributes.description: IRS-issued Preparer Tax Identification Number for the individual who prepared the filing. Required for paid tax return preparers in the United States.

attributes.name: public_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this filing is subject to public disclosure requirements. True for filings that must be made available for public inspection (e.g., IRS Form 990), false for confidential regulatory reports.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6104; Charity Commission Public Register; State Sunshine Laws

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority rejected the filing due to errors, omissions, or non-compliance. Triggers resubmission workflow.
attributes.references: IRS e-file Reject Codes; Charity Commission Rejection Notices

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code assigned by the regulatory authority indicating the specific reason for filing rejection. Used to identify and correct errors for resubmission. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IRS Reject Code 0001|0002|0003|0004|0005|0006|... — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS e-file Reject Code List; Charity Commission Error Codes

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the filing was rejected by the regulatory authority. Provides context and guidance for corrective action.
attributes.references: IRS e-file Reject Messages; Charity Commission Feedback

attributes.name: resubmission_count
attributes.description: Number of times this filing has been resubmitted after rejection. Tracks the iteration history for audit and quality improvement purposes.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the internal review and approval of the filing was completed. Marks the point at which the filing was deemed ready for submission.
attributes.references: Internal Control Framework; Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual responsible for reviewing and approving the regulatory filing before submission. Typically a senior finance officer, legal counsel, or executive director.
attributes.references: Internal Control Standards; Sarbanes-Oxley Section 302 (adapted for nonprofits)

attributes.name: reviewer_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the individual who reviewed and approved the filing. Examples include Chief Financial Officer (CFO), Executive Director, or Board Treasurer.
attributes.references: Nonprofit Governance Standards; IRS Form 990 Signature Requirements

attributes.name: submission_channel
attributes.description: Method or channel through which the filing was submitted to the regulatory authority. Distinguishes between electronic filing systems, paper mail, online portals, and third-party filing services.
attributes.references: IRS e-file Program; Charity Commission Online Filing Service

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the filing was submitted to the regulatory authority. Used to determine timeliness and compliance with due date requirements.
attributes.references: IRS e-file Transmission Records; Charity Commission Submission Logs

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the filing was transmitted to the regulatory authority or filing portal. Provides audit trail for electronic submissions.
attributes.references: IRS e-file Technical Specifications; Electronic Filing Standards

products.name: obligation
products.description: Master catalog of all recurring and one-time compliance obligations the organization must fulfill across regulatory, donor, and voluntary accountability frameworks. Includes IRS 990 filings, Charity Commission returns, IATI publications, CHS self-assessments, Single Audit requirements (2 CFR 200), state registrations, OCHA reporting, and donor-specific conditions. Captures obligation name, governing body, legal basis, frequency, jurisdiction, responsible unit, lead time, and risk rating. Overdue obligations escalate to incident records via obligation_schedule monitoring.
products.reference: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 / CHS Alliance

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for obligation

attributes.name: chs_self_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this obligation requires a self-assessment against the Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) commitments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compliance obligation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: documentation_required
attributes.description: Description of the documents, reports, or evidence that must be prepared or submitted to fulfill this obligation (e.g., 'Audited financial statements', 'Program impact report', 'Beneficiary data summary', 'Board meeting minutes').
attributes.references: Office of Management and Budget Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Financial Accounting Standards Board ASC 958

attributes.name: donor_funder_name
